docker-compose up.translation: Create and start all containers defined in the Compose file.

docker-credential-desktop.rationale: Helper that stores and retrieves Docker registry credentials.
docker-credential-desktop.translation: Manage Docker credentials using Docker Desktop.

docker-credential-gcloud.rationale: Helper that stores and retrieves Docker registry credentials via gcloud.
docker-credential-gcloud.translation: Manage Docker credentials using Google Cloud.

docker-credential-osxkeychain.rationale: Helper that stores and retrieves Docker registry credentials via Keychain.
docker-credential-osxkeychain.translation: Manage Docker credentials using the macOS Keychain.

docutils.rationale: Generates output files from documentation source; does not modify originals.
docutils.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to various formats.

dot_clean.rationale: Deletes ._ files that store macOS metadata.
dot_clean.translation: Remove Apple Double resource fork files from directories.

dotenv.rationale: Reads a file and exports variables; does not modify the file.
dotenv.translation: Load environment variables from a .env file.

dropdb.rationale: Permanently destroys the database and all its data with no confirmation by default.

dropdb-17.rationale: Permanently destroys the database and all its data.

dropuser.rationale: Permanently removes the role; objects owned by it may become inaccessible.

dropuser-17.rationale: Permanently removes the role; objects owned by it may become inaccessible.

drutil.rationale: Can eject, burn, or erase optical discs.
drutil.translation: Control the optical disc drive on macOS.

dscacheutil.rationale: Flushing the cache forces re-lookup of all directory data.
dscacheutil.translation: Query and flush the Directory Service cache.

dscl.rationale: Can create, read, modify, and delete directory entries including user accounts.
dscl.translation: Interact with the macOS Directory Service.

dsconfigad.rationale: Modifies domain binding that affects user authentication.
dsconfigad.translation: Configure Active Directory binding on macOS.

dsconfigldap.rationale: Modifies directory service configuration that affects authentication.
dsconfigldap.translation: Configure LDAP directory service on macOS.

dseditgroup.rationale: Modifies group membership, which affects access permissions.
dseditgroup.translation: Edit group records in the Directory Service.

dsenableroot.rationale: Enabling the root account creates a superuser login that bypasses normal security.
dsenableroot.translation: Enable or disable the root user account on macOS.

dsexport.translation: Export records from the macOS Directory Service.

dsimport.rationale: Adds or modifies user accounts and groups in the directory.
dsimport.translation: Import records into the macOS Directory Service.

dsmemberutil.rationale: Read-only tool that queries directory service membership information without making changes.

dsymutil.rationale: Creates debug symbol bundles; does not modify source code or binaries.

dtd2xsd.rationale: Schema conversion that outputs to the terminal.
dtd2xsd.translation: Convert document type definition schemas to XML schema format.

dtrace.rationale: Attaches to running processes and the kernel to observe behavior; read-only by default but can run destructive actions with -w.
dtrace.translation: Trace and monitor system and application activity in real time.

dtruss.rationale: Read-only tracing of system calls for debugging; requires root privileges.
dtruss.translation: Trace system calls of a process using DTrace.

du.rationale: Read-only display of disk usage statistics that does not modify anything.
du.translation: Show the disk space used by files and directories.

dwarfdump.translation: Display debug information from object files.

dyld_info.rationale: Read-only display of binary linking details.
dyld_info.translation: Display dynamic linker information for Apple platform binary files.

echo.rationale: Write-only output to the terminal that does not modify any files or system state.
echo.translation: Print text to the standard output.

ecpg.rationale: Generates C source code from embedded SQL; does not connect to or modify any database.
ecpg.translation: Preprocess embedded SQL in C source files for PostgreSQL.

ed.rationale: Edits files in place and can execute shell commands via the ! prefix.

egrep.rationale: Read-only search operation that modifies nothing.
egrep.translation: Search files for lines matching an extended regular expression pattern.

env.rationale: Without arguments, displays environment variables. With a command, runs it in a modified environment.
env.translation: Run a command with a modified environment or display the current environment variables.

envsubst.rationale: Reads from input and writes to the terminal; does not modify files directly.
envsubst.translation: Replace environment variable references in text with their values.

erb.rationale: Reads templates and writes output to the terminal; does not modify files in place.
erb.translation: Process Embedded Ruby template files and print the result.

errinfo.rationale: Read-only diagnostic tool that monitors system call failures without modifying anything.
errinfo.translation: Display system call errors for running processes using DTrace.

eslint.rationale: Read-only static analysis that reports problems but does not modify files by default.
eslint.translation: Analyze JavaScript and TypeScript code for style and correctness issues.

eslogger.rationale: Read-only monitoring tool that observes system events without modifying anything.
eslogger.translation: Stream Endpoint Security events to standard output or the system log.

ex.rationale: Edits files and can execute shell commands from within the editor.
ex.translation: Run the Vim text editor in command-line mode.

execsnoop.rationale: Read-only diagnostic tool that observes process creation without modifying anything.
execsnoop.translation: Monitor and display new process executions in real time using DTrace.

expand.rationale: Reads input and writes to the terminal; does not modify files in place.
expand.translation: Convert tabs to spaces in text.

expect.rationale: Executes scripts that spawn and control other programs, which may perform state-changing operations.
expect.translation: Automate interactions with programs that require user input.

export.rationale: Sets environment variables in the current shell session; does not modify files or persist beyond the session.
export.translation: Mark a shell variable so it is passed to any programs started from this shell.

expr.rationale: Read-only computation that prints a result and modifies nothing.
expr.translation: Evaluate a math or text expression and print the result.

false.rationale: Does nothing except return a failure exit code.
false.translation: Exit with a non-zero status code indicating failure.

fc.rationale: Can re-execute previous commands, which may include state-changing operations.
fc.translation: List or edit and re-execute previous shell commands.

fdesetup.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
fdesetup.translation: Run the macOS FileVault disk encryption configuration tool.

fdesetup add.rationale: Grants an additional user the ability to unlock the encrypted disk.
fdesetup add.translation: Add a user to the list of FileVault-enabled users.

fdesetup authrestart.rationale: Temporarily stores the encryption key in memory and the system management controller, reducing FileVault protection during restart.
fdesetup authrestart.translation: Restart the system bypassing the FileVault unlock screen.

fdesetup changerecovery.rationale: Replaces the recovery key, which is the last resort for unlocking an encrypted disk.
fdesetup changerecovery.translation: Change or add a FileVault recovery key.

fdesetup disable.rationale: Decrypts the entire startup disk, removing encryption protection from all data.
fdesetup disable.translation: Disable FileVault full-disk encryption on the startup volume.

fdesetup enable.rationale: Encrypts the entire startup disk, which requires a recovery key and changes boot behavior.
fdesetup enable.translation: Enable FileVault full-disk encryption on the startup volume.

fdesetup list.rationale: Read-only display of enabled FileVault users.
fdesetup list.translation: List the users enabled for FileVault.

fdesetup remove.rationale: Revokes a user's ability to unlock the disk; if done incorrectly, may lock out access.
fdesetup remove.translation: Remove a user from the list of FileVault-enabled users.

fdesetup removerecovery.rationale: Removes a recovery key without replacement, risking permanent data loss if the password is forgotten.

fdesetup status.rationale: Read-only query that reports encryption state.
fdesetup status.translation: Display the current FileVault encryption status.

fdesetup sync.rationale: Updates FileVault user attributes and may remove users deleted from Open Directory.
fdesetup sync.translation: Synchronize Open Directory user information with FileVault.

fdisk.rationale: Without flags, only displays the partition table as a read-only operation.
fdisk.translation: Display or modify the MBR partition table on a disk.

fg.rationale: Resumes an existing job in the foreground; does not create or destroy processes.
fg.translation: Bring a background or paused job into the foreground of the current terminal.

fgrep.rationale: Read-only search operation that modifies nothing.
fgrep.translation: Search files for lines matching a fixed string pattern.

file.rationale: Read-only analysis that inspects file contents without modifying anything.
file.translation: Identify the type of a file by examining its contents.

find.rationale: Read-only search that lists matching files without modifying them.
find.translation: Search for files and directories matching specified criteria.

finger.rationale: Read-only query of user account information.

flask.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
flask.translation: Run the Flask web application command-line interface.

flask routes.translation: Display all registered URL routes for the Flask application.

flask run.rationale: Starts a network-accessible server that executes application code and listens for connections.
flask run.translation: Start a local Flask development web server.

flask shell.rationale: Provides an interactive shell with access to the application and its database connections.
flask shell.translation: Open an interactive Python shell within the Flask application context.

flex.rationale: Generates source code from a lexer specification; does not execute the generated code.
flex.translation: Generate a C program that performs pattern matching on text input.

fly.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
fly.translation: Run the Fly.io cloud platform command-line tool.

fly apps create.rationale: Creates a new application resource on the platform.

fly apps destroy.rationale: Irrecoverably removes the application, all its machines, volumes, and configuration.

fly auth login.rationale: Stores credentials locally; does not modify applications.
fly auth login.translation: Log in to your Fly.io account.

fly auth logout.rationale: Removes locally stored authentication credentials, requiring the user to log in again.
fly auth logout.translation: Log out of your Fly.io account.

fly deploy.rationale: Builds and deploys code to a live service that receives production traffic.
fly deploy.translation: Deploy the current application to Fly.io.

fly launch.rationale: Creates a new application and may deploy it to the Fly.io platform.
fly launch.translation: Create and configure a new Fly.io application from source code or a Docker image.

fly logs.translation: View logs from a Fly.io application.

fly machine destroy.rationale: Removes the machine and its local state; persistent data on volumes is preserved.

fly machine start.rationale: Resumes a machine that will begin serving traffic.

fly machine stop.rationale: Halts the machine, interrupting any running workloads.

fly postgres.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

fly postgres create.rationale: Provisions a database cluster that incurs billing.
fly postgres create.translation: Create a new PostgreSQL cluster on Fly.io.

fly postgres destroy.rationale: Permanently removes the database and all its data.
fly postgres destroy.translation: Destroy a PostgreSQL cluster on Fly.io.

fly scale.rationale: Changes the number or size of machines, affecting availability and billing.

fly secrets set.rationale: Modifies application secrets and triggers a redeployment.
fly secrets set.translation: Set one or more secrets for a Fly.io application.

fly secrets unset.rationale: Removes secrets and triggers a redeployment; the application may break if it depends on them.
fly secrets unset.translation: Remove one or more secrets from a Fly.io application.

fly ssh console.rationale: Provides remote shell access to a running machine.
fly ssh console.translation: Open an SSH console on a Fly.io machine.

fly status.translation: Show the status of a Fly.io application.

fly volumes.translation: Manage persistent storage volumes on Fly.io.

fly volumes create.translation: Create a new persistent storage volume on Fly.io.

fly volumes destroy.rationale: Irrecoverably deletes the volume and all data stored on it.

fmt.rationale: Reads input and writes reformatted text to the terminal; does not modify files in place.
fmt.translation: Reformat text to fit within a specified line width.

fold.rationale: Reads input and writes wrapped text to the terminal; does not modify files in place.
fold.translation: Wrap lines of text to fit a specified width.

footprint.rationale: Read-only diagnostic tool that inspects process memory without modifying anything.
footprint.translation: Display memory usage information for one or more processes.

fping.rationale: Read-only network diagnostic that sends ICMP echo requests and reports responses.
fping.translation: Send ICMP ping requests to multiple hosts in parallel.

fs_usage.rationale: Read-only diagnostic tool that traces filesystem activity without modifying anything.
fs_usage.translation: Monitor filesystem-related system calls and page faults in real time.

fsck.rationale: Modifies filesystem metadata to fix inconsistencies, which can cause data loss if the filesystem is mounted.

funzip.rationale: Reads from an archive and writes to the terminal; does not modify the archive or create files on disk.
funzip.translation: Extract the first file from a ZIP archive, writing it to the terminal.

fuser.rationale: Read-only query that reports which processes are using a file.
fuser.translation: List the process IDs of all processes that have a specified file open.

g++.rationale: Compiles source code into object files or executables; does not execute the compiled output.
g++.translation: Compile C++ source code into executable programs.

gcc.rationale: Compiles source code into object files or executables; does not execute the compiled output.
gcc.translation: Compile C and C++ source code into executable programs.

gcloud.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
gcloud.translation: Run the Google Cloud command-line tool.

gcloud app.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud app browse.rationale: Opens a URL; does not modify the application.
gcloud app browse.translation: Open the deployed App Engine application in a browser.

gcloud app deploy.rationale: Publishes code to a live service that may receive production traffic.
gcloud app deploy.translation: Deploy an application to Google App Engine.

gcloud app logs read.translation: Display log entries for an App Engine application.

gcloud auth.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gcloud auth.translation: Manage authentication for the Google Cloud CLI.

gcloud auth application-default login.rationale: Stores credentials locally for use by client libraries.
gcloud auth application-default login.translation: Set up application default credentials for local development.

gcloud auth list.translation: List the accounts currently authenticated with the CLI.

gcloud auth login.rationale: Stores credentials locally; does not modify cloud resources.
gcloud auth login.translation: Log in to a Google Cloud account.

gcloud auth revoke.rationale: Removes stored credentials, which may break automated workflows that depend on them.
gcloud auth revoke.translation: Revoke credentials for a Google Cloud account.

gcloud components install.rationale: Downloads and installs a CLI component locally.
gcloud components install.translation: Install a new component of the Google Cloud CLI.

gcloud components update.rationale: Updates local CLI binaries; does not affect cloud resources.
gcloud components update.translation: Update all installed Google Cloud CLI components to the latest version.

gcloud compute.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud compute config-ssh.rationale: Edits the local user's SSH config; does not modify any cloud resource and does not open a session.
gcloud compute config-ssh.translation: Update the local SSH client config so Compute Engine instances can be reached by name with plain `ssh`.

gcloud compute disks.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud compute disks create.translation: Create a new Compute Engine persistent disk.

gcloud compute disks delete.rationale: Permanently destroys disk data with no undo; recovery requires snapshots or backups.
gcloud compute disks delete.translation: Delete one or more Compute Engine persistent disks.

gcloud compute disks snapshot.rationale: Creates a backup copy; does not modify the source disk.
gcloud compute disks snapshot.translation: Create a snapshot of a Compute Engine persistent disk.

gcloud compute firewall-rules create.rationale: Opens network access paths that may expose services to unauthorized traffic.
gcloud compute firewall-rules create.translation: Create a new Compute Engine firewall rule.

gcloud compute firewall-rules delete.rationale: Removes a network access control, which may block legitimate traffic or expose previously filtered services.
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete.translation: Delete a Compute Engine firewall rule.

gcloud compute firewall-rules update.rationale: Changes network access controls that affect traffic flow to running services.
gcloud compute firewall-rules update.translation: Modify an existing Compute Engine firewall rule.

gcloud compute instances create.rationale: Provisions a billable VM that consumes project resources.
gcloud compute instances create.translation: Create a new Compute Engine virtual machine instance.

gcloud compute instances delete.rationale: Permanently removes VMs and by default their boot disks; data on non-persistent disks is lost.
gcloud compute instances delete.translation: Delete one or more Compute Engine virtual machine instances.

gcloud compute instances describe.translation: Show details about a Compute Engine instance.

gcloud compute instances list.translation: List Compute Engine virtual machine instances.

gcloud compute instances reset.rationale: Performs an ungraceful restart that may cause data loss in unflushed buffers.

gcloud compute instances ssh.rationale: Opens a remote shell for arbitrary command execution on the instance.
gcloud compute instances ssh.translation: Open an SSH session to a Compute Engine instance.

gcloud compute instances start.rationale: Resumes a VM that will begin incurring compute charges.
gcloud compute instances start.translation: Start a stopped Compute Engine instance.

gcloud compute instances stop.rationale: Shuts down the VM, interrupting any running workloads.
gcloud compute instances stop.translation: Stop a running Compute Engine instance.

gcloud compute reset-windows-password.rationale: Generates new credentials for a remote Windows host; anyone holding the output can log in until the password is changed again.
gcloud compute reset-windows-password.translation: Reset the password for a Windows user on a Compute Engine instance and return the new credentials.

gcloud compute scp.rationale: Transfers files to or from a remote instance over SSH; can write arbitrary content to remote disks or pull data from them.
gcloud compute scp.translation: Securely copy files between the local machine and a Compute Engine instance over SSH, using gcloud-managed authentication.

gcloud compute ssh.rationale: Opens a remote shell for arbitrary command execution on the instance; gcloud handles key provisioning and IAP tunneling but the underlying capability is the same as plain ssh.
gcloud compute ssh.translation: Open an SSH session to a Compute Engine instance using gcloud-managed authentication.

gcloud config get.rationale: Read-only display of a configuration value.
gcloud config get.translation: Display the value of a CLI configuration property.

gcloud config list.translation: List all properties in the active CLI configuration.

gcloud config set.rationale: Changes local CLI behavior; does not modify cloud resources.
gcloud config set.translation: Set a Google Cloud CLI configuration property.

gcloud config unset.rationale: Resets a property to its default; only affects local CLI behavior.

gcloud container.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud container clusters create.rationale: Provisions billable compute and networking infrastructure.

gcloud container clusters delete.rationale: Destroys the cluster, all running workloads, and associated resources; persistent data may be lost.
gcloud container clusters delete.translation: Delete a GKE cluster and its node instances.

gcloud container clusters describe.translation: Show details about a GKE cluster.

gcloud container clusters get-credential.rationale: Updates the local kubeconfig file; does not modify the cluster.
gcloud container clusters get-credential.translation: Fetch cluster credentials and configure kubectl to use them.

gcloud container clusters resize.rationale: Scaling down removes nodes and evicts running workloads, potentially disrupting services.
gcloud container clusters resize.translation: Change the number of nodes in a GKE cluster node pool.

gcloud container clusters update.rationale: Modifies cluster configuration, which may trigger node restarts or affect availability.
gcloud container clusters update.translation: Update settings on a GKE cluster.

gcloud functions.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud functions call.rationale: Triggers function execution, which may have side effects depending on the function's logic.
gcloud functions call.translation: Invoke a Google Cloud Function directly.

gcloud functions delete.rationale: Permanently removes the function; any triggers pointing to it will stop working.

gcloud functions deploy.rationale: Deploys code that will execute in response to events or HTTP requests.

gcloud functions logs read.translation: Display log entries for a Cloud Function.

gcloud iam.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gcloud iam.translation: Manage IAM service accounts and policies.

gcloud iam service-accounts create.rationale: Creates a new identity that can be granted permissions to cloud resources.
gcloud iam service-accounts create.translation: Create a new IAM service account.

gcloud iam service-accounts delete.rationale: Removes the service account; applications using it will lose access to cloud resources.

gcloud iam service-accounts keys create.rationale: Generates a credential file that grants access to cloud resources; must be securely stored.
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create.translation: Create a new key for an IAM service account.

gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete.rationale: Revokes a credential; applications using it will lose authentication.
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete.translation: Delete a key from an IAM service account.

gcloud iam service-accounts list.translation: List IAM service accounts in a project.

gcloud info.rationale: Read-only display of CLI installation details.
gcloud info.translation: Display information about the current gcloud environment.

gcloud init.rationale: Configures local CLI settings; does not create or modify cloud resources.
gcloud init.translation: Set up the Google Cloud CLI with a project, account, and default settings.

gcloud projects.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud projects create.rationale: Creates a new project that may incur billing and consume organizational quota.
gcloud projects create.translation: Create a new Google Cloud project.

gcloud projects delete.rationale: Schedules the project and all its resources for permanent deletion after a grace period.
gcloud projects delete.translation: Mark a Google Cloud project for deletion.

gcloud projects describe.translation: Show metadata for a Google Cloud project.

gcloud projects list.translation: List all Google Cloud projects accessible by the active account.

gcloud run.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gcloud run.translation: Manage Cloud Run services and jobs.

gcloud run deploy.rationale: Deploys code to a live service that may receive production traffic.
gcloud run deploy.translation: Create or update a Cloud Run service with a new container image.

gcloud run services delete.rationale: Permanently removes the service and all its revisions; incoming traffic will return errors.

gcloud run services describe.translation: Show details about a Cloud Run service.

gcloud sql.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gcloud sql databases create.rationale: Adds a database to the instance.
gcloud sql databases create.translation: Create a new database in a Cloud SQL instance.

gcloud sql databases delete.rationale: Permanently removes the database and all its data from the instance.
gcloud sql databases delete.translation: Delete a database from a Cloud SQL instance.

gcloud sql databases list.translation: List databases in a Cloud SQL instance.

gcloud sql instances create.translation: Create a new Cloud SQL database instance.

gcloud sql instances delete.rationale: Permanently destroys the database instance and all its data unless a final backup is taken.
gcloud sql instances delete.translation: Delete a Cloud SQL database instance.

gcloud sql instances describe.translation: Show details about a Cloud SQL instance.

gcloud sql instances patch.rationale: Modifies database configuration, which may cause a restart or affect availability.
gcloud sql instances patch.translation: Update settings on a Cloud SQL instance.

gcloud sql instances restart.rationale: Temporarily interrupts database availability during the restart.

gcloud storage.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gcloud storage.translation: Manage Cloud Storage buckets and objects.

gcloud storage buckets create.rationale: Creates a new storage resource that will incur costs.
gcloud storage buckets create.translation: Create a new Cloud Storage bucket.

gcloud storage buckets delete.rationale: Permanently removes the bucket; must be empty first but the bucket name may not be reusable.
gcloud storage buckets delete.translation: Delete one or more Cloud Storage buckets.

gcloud storage cat.translation: Output the contents of a Cloud Storage object to the terminal.

gcloud storage cp.rationale: Transfers data to or from Cloud Storage, potentially overwriting existing objects.
gcloud storage cp.translation: Upload, download, or copy Cloud Storage objects.

gcloud storage ls.translation: List Cloud Storage buckets or objects.

gcloud storage rm.rationale: Permanently removes objects from Cloud Storage.
gcloud storage rm.translation: Delete Cloud Storage objects or buckets.

gcore.rationale: Captures the full memory state of a process, which may include sensitive data like passwords or keys.
gcore.translation: Create a core dump file from a running process.

gem.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

gem build.rationale: Creates a local .gem file; does not publish it.
gem build.translation: Build a gem package from a gemspec file.

gem cleanup.rationale: Deletes older gem versions from the local system.
gem cleanup.translation: Remove old versions of installed gems.

gem install.rationale: Downloads and installs packages that may execute native extension build scripts.
gem install.translation: Download and install a Ruby gem and its dependencies.

gem push.rationale: Publishes the gem publicly; published versions are difficult to fully remove.
gem push.translation: Upload a gem package to the RubyGems repository.

gem search.rationale: Read-only search of the remote repository.
gem search.translation: Search for gems on the RubyGems repository.

gem uninstall.rationale: Removes a locally installed gem; can be reinstalled.

gem update.rationale: Downloads and installs newer versions that may introduce breaking changes.
gem update.translation: Update installed gems to the latest versions.

gh.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

gh api.rationale: Can read or modify any GitHub resource the authenticated user has access to.
gh api.translation: Make an authenticated request to the GitHub API.

gh auth.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh auth.translation: Manage authentication state for the GitHub CLI.

gh auth login.rationale: Stores credentials locally; does not modify any remote resources.
gh auth login.translation: Log in to a GitHub account.

gh auth logout.rationale: Removes stored credentials, which may disrupt automated workflows that depend on them.
gh auth logout.translation: Log out of a GitHub account.

gh browse.rationale: Opens a URL in the browser; does not modify any resources.
gh browse.translation: Open the current repository in a web browser.

gh cache.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh cache.translation: Manage GitHub Actions caches for a repository.

gh cache delete.rationale: Removes cached data that may need to be rebuilt, slowing future workflow runs.
gh cache delete.translation: Delete one or more GitHub Actions caches.

gh cache list.translation: List GitHub Actions caches in a repository.

gh gist.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh gist create.rationale: Publishes content to GitHub that may be publicly visible.
gh gist create.translation: Create a new gist on GitHub.

gh gist delete.rationale: Removes the gist and all its files irreversibly; others may have linked to it.
gh gist delete.translation: Permanently delete a gist from GitHub.

gh gist edit.rationale: Changes published gist content that others may have linked to.
gh gist edit.translation: Modify the contents of a gist.

gh gist list.rationale: Read-only operation that lists the user's gists without modifying or deleting any of them.

gh gist view.translation: Display the contents of a gist.

gh issue.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh issue close.rationale: Changes the issue state; can be reopened.

gh issue comment.rationale: Posts a publicly visible comment on the issue.
gh issue comment.translation: Add a comment to an issue.

gh issue create.rationale: Publishes an issue visible to repository collaborators or the public.
gh issue create.translation: Create a new issue on GitHub.

gh issue delete.rationale: Removes the issue and all its comments irreversibly.
gh issue delete.translation: Permanently delete an issue from GitHub.

gh issue edit.rationale: Updates issue metadata without deleting anything.
gh issue edit.translation: Modify an issue's title, body, or metadata.

gh issue list.rationale: Read-only operation that lists repository issues without modifying or closing any of them.

gh issue reopen.rationale: Restores a closed issue to open state.

gh issue status.translation: Show the status of issues relevant to you.

gh issue transfer.rationale: Transfers the issue, changing its URL and repository context.
gh issue transfer.translation: Move an issue to a different repository.

gh label.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh label.translation: Manage labels on a GitHub repository.

gh label create.rationale: Adds a label definition; does not modify any issues or pull requests.
gh label create.translation: Create a new label in a repository.

gh label delete.rationale: Removes the label from all issues and pull requests that use it.
gh label delete.translation: Delete a label from a repository.

gh label edit.rationale: Changes label metadata; does not remove the label from any issues.
gh label edit.translation: Modify an existing label's name, description, or color.

gh pr.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh pr checkout.rationale: Creates or switches to a local branch; does not modify the remote.
gh pr checkout.translation: Check out a pull request's branch locally.

gh pr checks.rationale: Read-only display of check run results.
gh pr checks.translation: Show the CI check status for a pull request.

gh pr close.rationale: Closes the PR, stopping the review process; can be reopened.
gh pr close.translation: Close a pull request without merging it.

gh pr comment.rationale: Posts a publicly visible comment on the pull request.
gh pr comment.translation: Add a comment to a pull request.

gh pr create.rationale: Publishes a pull request visible to repository collaborators.
gh pr create.translation: Create a new pull request on GitHub.

gh pr diff.rationale: Read-only display of the pull request diff.
gh pr diff.translation: Show the changes in a pull request.

gh pr edit.rationale: Updates PR metadata; does not affect code or branch state.
gh pr edit.translation: Modify a pull request's title, body, or metadata.

gh pr list.translation: List pull requests in a repository.

gh pr merge.rationale: Integrates changes into the base branch, modifying the shared repository history.
gh pr merge.translation: Merge a pull request on GitHub.

gh pr reopen.rationale: Restores a closed PR to open state; no destructive changes.
gh pr reopen.translation: Reopen a previously closed pull request.

gh pr revert.rationale: Creates a revert PR that, if merged, undoes changes in the base branch.
gh pr revert.translation: Create a new pull request that reverts a previously merged pull request.

gh pr review.rationale: Publishes a review visible to collaborators that may approve or block merging.
gh pr review.translation: Add a review to a pull request.

gh pr status.rationale: Read-only summary of your pull requests.
gh pr status.translation: Show the status of pull requests relevant to you.

gh pr view.rationale: Read-only display of pull request metadata.
gh pr view.translation: Display details about a pull request.

gh release.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh release create.rationale: Publishes a release with assets visible to repository users; may auto-create a tag.
gh release create.translation: Create a new release on GitHub.

gh release delete.rationale: Permanently removes the release and its metadata; assets may become inaccessible.

gh release download.rationale: Downloads files to the local machine; does not modify the remote release.
gh release download.translation: Download assets from a GitHub release.

gh release edit.rationale: Changes a published release that users may be consuming.
gh release edit.translation: Modify a release's metadata or assets.

gh repo.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh repo archive.rationale: Prevents further changes to the repository; reversible via unarchive.
gh repo archive.translation: Archive a GitHub repository, making it read-only.

gh repo clone.rationale: Creates a new local directory; does not modify the remote repository.
gh repo clone.translation: Download a GitHub repository to the local machine.

gh repo create.rationale: Creates a new remote resource visible to others depending on visibility settings.
gh repo create.translation: Create a new repository on GitHub.

gh repo delete.rationale: Irrecoverably removes the repository, all issues, pull requests, and settings from GitHub.

gh repo edit.rationale: Changes repository configuration such as visibility, description, or features.
gh repo edit.translation: Modify settings of a GitHub repository.

gh repo fork.rationale: Creates a new remote repository under your account.
gh repo fork.translation: Create a personal copy of someone else's repository on GitHub.

gh repo list.translation: List repositories owned by a user or organization.

gh repo rename.rationale: Changes the repository URL, which may break existing links and integrations.

gh repo sync.rationale: Updates branch refs to match the upstream, which may overwrite divergent local changes.
gh repo sync.translation: Sync a forked repository with its upstream.

gh repo unarchive.rationale: Reverses an archive operation; restores normal repository functionality.
gh repo unarchive.translation: Unarchive a GitHub repository, restoring write access.

gh repo view.translation: Display details about a GitHub repository.

gh run.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh run cancel.rationale: Stops a workflow run that may be performing deployments or other important tasks.

gh run delete.rationale: Permanently removes run history and artifacts, which may be needed for auditing.
gh run delete.translation: Delete a workflow run and its logs.

gh run download.rationale: Downloads files to the local machine; does not modify the remote run.
gh run download.translation: Download artifacts from a workflow run.

gh run rerun.rationale: Triggers a new execution that may deploy code or consume resources.

gh run view.rationale: Read-only display of run details and logs.
gh run view.translation: Display details about a workflow run.

gh run watch.rationale: Read-only monitoring of a running workflow.
gh run watch.translation: Watch a workflow run until it completes.

gh search.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh search.translation: Search across GitHub for repositories, issues, pull requests, and more.

gh search code.rationale: Read-only search that lists matching code snippets.
gh search code.translation: Search for code across GitHub repositories.

gh search commits.rationale: Read-only search that lists matching commits.

gh search issues.rationale: Read-only search that lists matching issues.

gh search prs.rationale: Read-only search that lists matching pull requests.
gh search prs.translation: Search for pull requests across GitHub.

gh search repos.rationale: Read-only search that lists matching repositories.

gh secret.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh secret.translation: Manage GitHub secrets for Actions, Codespaces, or Dependabot.

gh secret delete.rationale: Removes a secret that may be required by running workflows, potentially breaking deployments.
gh secret delete.translation: Delete a secret from a repository or organization.

gh secret list.rationale: Read-only listing of secret names; values are not displayed.
gh secret list.translation: List secrets in a repository or organization.

gh secret set.rationale: Stores sensitive values that are used by workflows and services.
gh secret set.translation: Create or update a secret in a repository or organization.

gh ssh-key.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh ssh-key.translation: Manage SSH keys registered with your GitHub account.

gh ssh-key add.rationale: Grants a new key access to your account for Git operations over SSH.
gh ssh-key add.translation: Add an SSH key to your GitHub account.

gh ssh-key delete.rationale: Revokes access for that key, which may break automated systems that depend on it.
gh ssh-key delete.translation: Remove an SSH key from your GitHub account.

gh ssh-key list.translation: List SSH keys registered with your GitHub account.

gh variable.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
gh variable.translation: Manage GitHub Actions variables for a repository or organization.

gh variable delete.rationale: Removes a variable that may be required by running workflows, potentially breaking builds.

gh variable list.rationale: Read-only listing of variable names and values.
gh variable list.translation: List GitHub Actions variables in a repository or organization.

gh variable set.rationale: Changes a variable value that running workflows may depend on.
gh variable set.translation: Create or update a GitHub Actions variable.

gh workflow.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

gh workflow disable.rationale: Prevents the workflow from running, which may break CI/CD pipelines that depend on it.
gh workflow disable.translation: Disable a workflow so it no longer runs automatically.

gh workflow enable.rationale: Re-enables a workflow; it will only run when triggered by future events.
gh workflow enable.translation: Enable a workflow that was previously disabled.

gh workflow run.rationale: Starts a new workflow execution that may deploy code, consume resources, or modify infrastructure.
gh workflow run.translation: Trigger a workflow run by dispatching a workflow event.

gh workflow view.rationale: Read-only display of workflow configuration and recent runs.

git.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
git.translation: Run the Git version control system.

git add.rationale: Only updates the staging area; no committed data is changed.
git add.translation: Stage file changes for the next commit.

git am.rationale: Creates new commits on the current branch; may produce conflicts.
git am.translation: Apply a series of patches from email-formatted files to the current branch.

git bisect.rationale: Navigates history by checking out commits; the original branch is restored with bisect reset.
git bisect.translation: Use binary search to find the commit that introduced a bug.

git blame.translation: Show which commit and author last modified each line of a file.

git branch.rationale: Without flags, lists branches; creating a branch is trivially reversible.

git checkout.rationale: Modifies the working tree; uncommitted changes on conflicting paths may be overwritten.
git checkout.translation: Switch branches or restore files in the working tree.

git cherry-pick.rationale: Creates a new commit on the current branch; may produce conflicts.
git cherry-pick.translation: Apply the changes from a specific commit onto the current branch.

git clean.rationale: Permanently deletes files that are not tracked by Git; no built-in recovery.
git clean.translation: Remove untracked files from the working tree.

git clone.rationale: Creates a new directory; does not modify any existing files.
git clone.translation: Download a remote repository and create a local copy.

git commit.rationale: Creates a local commit that can be amended or reset; does not affect the remote.
git commit.translation: Save the staged changes as a new commit in the repository history.

git config.rationale: Without arguments, prints help. Reading config values is read-only.
git config.translation: View or modify Git configuration settings.

git config --global.rationale: Changes apply to every repository the user interacts with, not just the current one.
git config --global.translation: View or modify Git configuration settings for all repositories on this machine.

git diff.translation: Show the differences between files or commits.

git fetch.rationale: Only updates remote-tracking references; the working tree and local branches are unchanged.
git fetch.translation: Download new commits and branch information from a remote repository without modifying local branches.

git format-patch.rationale: Creates files on disk; does not modify the repository.
git format-patch.translation: Generate patch files from commits for email-based review or sharing.

git gc.rationale: Permanently deletes unreachable objects after the grace period, making some recovery operations impossible.
git gc.translation: Run housekeeping to compress repository data and remove unreachable objects.

git grep.rationale: Read-only search that does not modify files.
git grep.translation: Search for a text pattern in tracked files.

git init.rationale: Creates a .git directory; safe to run in an existing repo without data loss.
git init.translation: Create a new empty Git repository in the current directory.

git merge.rationale: Modifies the current branch and working tree; can produce merge conflicts.
git merge.translation: Combine another branch's changes into the current branch.

git mv.rationale: Renames files in the working tree and staging area; fully reversible.
git mv.translation: Move or rename a tracked file, directory, or symbolic link.

git pull.rationale: Modifies the working tree and branch history; can introduce merge conflicts.
git pull.translation: Download changes from a remote repository and merge them into the current branch.

git push.rationale: Publishes local changes to a shared remote; incorrect pushes can disrupt collaborators.
git push.translation: Upload local commits to a remote repository.

git rebase.rationale: Rewrites commit history; can cause data loss if used on shared branches.
git rebase.translation: Reapply commits from the current branch onto a different base commit.

git reflog.rationale: Read-only display useful for recovering lost commits.
git reflog.translation: Show a log of every position the branch pointer has been moved to in the local repository.

git remote.translation: List the remote repositories connected to this repository.

git remote add.rationale: Adds a configuration entry; does not transfer any data.
git remote add.translation: Register a new remote repository under a given name.

git remote remove.rationale: Removes the remote configuration and all associated remote-tracking refs.
git remote remove.translation: Unregister a remote repository and delete its tracking branches.

git reset.rationale: Changes which commit the branch points to; can unstage changes or rewrite local history.
git reset.translation: Move the current branch pointer to a different commit.

git restore.rationale: Overwrites working tree files with versions from another source; uncommitted changes to those files are lost.
git restore.translation: Restore files in the working tree to a previous state.

git revert.rationale: Modifies the branch by adding a new commit; safe because it does not rewrite history.
git revert.translation: Create a new commit that undoes the changes from a previous commit.

git rm.rationale: Deletes files from disk and stages the removal; recoverable from committed history.
git rm.translation: Remove files from the working tree and the staging area.

git show.translation: Display the details and content changes of a specific commit.

git stash.rationale: Changes are stored in the stash and can be reapplied later.
git stash.translation: Temporarily save uncommitted changes and revert the working tree to a clean state.

git stash apply.rationale: Modifies the working tree but keeps the stash entry intact for later use.
git stash apply.translation: Reapply the most recently stashed changes without removing them from the stash.

git stash clear.rationale: Permanently removes all stashed changes, but stash is local-only and entries are recoverable from reflog with effort.
git stash clear.translation: Delete all entries from the stash.

git stash drop.rationale: Permanently removes stashed changes; they cannot be easily recovered.
git stash drop.translation: Delete a specific entry from the stash.

git stash pop.rationale: Modifies the working tree; the stash entry is deleted if applied cleanly, making it harder to retry.
git stash pop.translation: Reapply the most recently stashed changes and remove them from the stash.

git stash show.translation: Show a summary of changes in a stash entry.

git status.rationale: Read-only display of working tree state.
git status.translation: Show which files have been modified, staged, or are untracked in the working tree.

git submodule.rationale: Without arguments, shows submodule status; read-only operation.
git submodule.translation: Inspect the status of submodules in this repository.

git submodule add.rationale: Adds a new dependency; does not modify existing code.
git submodule add.translation: Register a new submodule and clone it into the working tree.

git submodule deinit.rationale: Removes submodule working tree data; can be re-initialized later.
git submodule deinit.translation: Unregister submodules and remove their working tree contents.

git submodule update.rationale: Checks out specific commits in submodules, modifying their working trees.
git submodule update.translation: Update submodules to the commit recorded in the parent repository.

git switch.rationale: Moves to an existing branch; safer than checkout because it refuses to overwrite uncommitted changes by default.

git tag.rationale: Creating or listing tags is trivially reversible and does not modify branch history.
git tag.translation: Create, list, or manage tags that mark specific commits.

git update-ref.rationale: Low-level command that moves branch pointers without the safety checks of normal branch operations.
git update-ref.translation: Directly move a branch pointer or other reference to a different commit.

git worktree add.rationale: Creates a new directory; does not affect the existing working tree.
git worktree add.translation: Create a new working tree linked to this repository at a different path.

git worktree list.translation: List all working trees linked to this repository.

git worktree prune.rationale: Cleans up metadata for worktrees that have already been deleted from disk.
git worktree prune.translation: Remove stale working tree administrative data.

git worktree remove.rationale: Removes a working tree directory; uncommitted changes in it will be lost.
git worktree remove.translation: Delete a linked working tree and its administrative files.

git-lfs.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
git-lfs.translation: Run the Git Large File Storage extension.

git-lfs checkout.rationale: Populates the working tree with real content from the local LFS cache.
git-lfs checkout.translation: Replace LFS pointer files in the working tree with actual file content.

git-lfs dedup.rationale: Replaces duplicate copies with hard links or copies; file content is preserved.
git-lfs dedup.translation: De-duplicate Git LFS files in the local store to save disk space.

git-lfs env.translation: Display the current Git LFS environment and configuration.

git-lfs fetch.rationale: Downloads LFS objects to the local cache; does not modify the working tree.
git-lfs fetch.translation: Download Git LFS files from a remote without checking them out.

git-lfs fsck.rationale: Read-only integrity check that modifies nothing.
git-lfs fsck.translation: Check Git LFS files for consistency and corruption.

git-lfs install.rationale: Adds configuration entries for smudge/clean filters; does not modify repository content.
git-lfs install.translation: Install Git LFS hooks and filters into the Git configuration.

git-lfs lock.rationale: Prevents other collaborators from pushing changes to the locked file.
git-lfs lock.translation: Mark a file as locked on the Git LFS server to prevent others from editing it.

git-lfs locks.translation: List currently locked files on the Git LFS server.

git-lfs logs.rationale: Read-only display of error log entries.
git-lfs logs.translation: Show recent error logs from Git LFS commands.

git-lfs ls-files.translation: List Git LFS files in the index and working tree.

git-lfs migrate.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
git-lfs migrate.translation: Convert files in the repository history to or from Git LFS.

git-lfs migrate export.rationale: Rewrites commit history to replace LFS pointers with full blobs; requires a force-push to share.
git-lfs migrate export.translation: Convert Git LFS pointers back to regular Git files, rewriting history.

git-lfs migrate import.rationale: Rewrites commit history to replace blobs with LFS pointers; requires a force-push to share.
git-lfs migrate import.translation: Convert regular Git files to Git LFS pointers, rewriting history.

git-lfs migrate info.rationale: Read-only analysis of repository file sizes.
git-lfs migrate info.translation: Show a summary of file sizes by type to help decide what to migrate.

git-lfs prune.rationale: Removes local copies of LFS objects that are still available on the remote.
git-lfs prune.translation: Delete old Git LFS files from local storage to free disk space.

git-lfs pull.rationale: Replaces pointer files with actual file content; working tree changes are expected.
git-lfs pull.translation: Download Git LFS files from a remote and check them out into the working tree.

git-lfs push.rationale: Sends large file content to the remote LFS store, consuming storage quota.
git-lfs push.translation: Upload Git LFS files to a remote server.

git-lfs status.rationale: Read-only display of LFS file states.
git-lfs status.translation: Show the status of Git LFS files in the working tree.

git-lfs track.rationale: Modifies .gitattributes to mark file types for LFS tracking; does not move existing data.
git-lfs track.translation: Add file patterns to be tracked by Git LFS.

git-lfs uninstall.rationale: Removes LFS filter configuration, which may cause LFS-tracked files to appear as pointer files on future checkouts.
git-lfs uninstall.translation: Remove Git LFS hooks and filters from the Git configuration.

git-lfs unlock.rationale: Releases a lock, allowing others to edit the file again.
git-lfs unlock.translation: Remove the lock on a file on the Git LFS server.

git-lfs untrack.rationale: Stops tracking file types in LFS, which may cause large files to be stored directly in Git on future commits.
git-lfs untrack.translation: Remove file patterns from Git LFS tracking.

git-lfs update.rationale: Refreshes hook scripts; does not modify tracked files or history.
git-lfs update.translation: Update Git hooks for the current repository to use Git LFS.

go.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
go.translation: Run the Go programming language toolchain.

go build.rationale: Compiles source code locally; does not execute the resulting binary.
go build.translation: Compile Go packages and their dependencies into an executable.

go clean.rationale: Deletes build output files; they can be regenerated but deletion takes effect immediately.
go clean.translation: Remove compiled object files and cached build artifacts.

go fmt.rationale: Modifies source files in place, but changes are cosmetic and easily reversible with version control.
go fmt.translation: Reformat Go source files to match the standard style.

go get.rationale: Downloads third-party code from the internet and updates dependency files.
go get.translation: Download and install Go modules and their dependencies.

go install.rationale: Downloads, compiles, and places a binary on the system path.
go install.translation: Compile and install a Go package or executable into the Go bin directory.

go mod.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text and modifies nothing.

go mod tidy.rationale: Updates go.mod and go.sum files; changes are local and reversible.
go mod tidy.translation: Add missing and remove unused module dependencies.

go run.rationale: Compiles and runs arbitrary Go code, which can modify files or make network requests.
go run.translation: Compile and immediately execute a Go program.

go test.rationale: Compiles and executes test code, which may have side effects depending on the tests.
go test.translation: Run the tests for Go packages.

go vet.rationale: Read-only static analysis; does not modify any files.
go vet.translation: Check Go source code for common mistakes.

gpg.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
gpg.translation: Encrypt, decrypt, and sign data using the GNU Privacy Guard.

gpg --decrypt.rationale: Reads encrypted data and outputs the plaintext; does not modify the encrypted file.
gpg --decrypt.translation: Decrypt an encrypted file or message.

gpg --delete-keys.rationale: Permanently removes public keys; they must be re-imported if needed.
gpg --delete-keys.translation: Remove public keys from the keyring.

gpg --delete-secret-keys.rationale: Permanently removes private keys; without a backup the key is irrecoverable.
gpg --delete-secret-keys.translation: Remove private keys from the keyring.

gpg --edit-key.rationale: Modifies key attributes that affect trust and usability.
gpg --edit-key.translation: Edit key properties such as trust level and expiration.

gpg --encrypt.rationale: Creates an encrypted copy of the input; the original file is not modified.
gpg --encrypt.translation: Encrypt data for one or more recipients.

gpg --export.rationale: Reads keys and outputs them; the keyring is not modified.
gpg --export.translation: Export public keys from the keyring to a file.

gpg --fingerprint.rationale: Read-only display of key fingerprint information.
gpg --fingerprint.translation: Display the fingerprint of a key.

gpg --gen-key.rationale: Creates a persistent key pair in the keyring that can be used for authentication and encryption.
gpg --gen-key.translation: Generate a new key pair for encryption and signing.

gpg --import.rationale: Adds keys to the local keyring; does not modify existing keys.
gpg --import.translation: Import keys from a file into the keyring.

gpg --list-keys.rationale: Read-only display of stored public keys.
gpg --list-keys.translation: List all public keys in the keyring.

gpg --list-secret-keys.rationale: Read-only display of stored private keys.
gpg --list-secret-keys.translation: List all private keys in the keyring.

gpg --recv-keys.rationale: Imports keys from a remote server into the local keyring.
gpg --recv-keys.translation: Download public keys from a key server.

gpg --send-keys.rationale: Publishes keys to a public server; once uploaded, keys cannot be removed from the server.
gpg --send-keys.translation: Upload public keys to a key server.

gpg --sign.rationale: Creates a signed copy; the original file is not modified.
gpg --sign.translation: Create a digital signature on a file or message.

gpg --verify.rationale: Read-only validation of a signature; modifies nothing.

gpg-agent.rationale: Starts a background agent process; no keys are exposed without explicit requests.
gpg-agent.translation: Run the GnuPG private key agent to cache passphrases and manage private keys.

grep.rationale: Read-only search that displays matching lines without modifying any files.
grep.translation: Search file contents for lines matching a pattern.

groups.rationale: Read-only query that prints group names.
groups.translation: Display the group memberships of a user.

gunzip.rationale: Replaces compressed files with their decompressed versions, removing the original compressed file.

gzip.rationale: Compresses files in place, replacing the original with a .gz file by default.
gzip.translation: Compress files using the gzip algorithm.

halt.rationale: Immediately terminates all processes and powers off the machine, causing loss of any unsaved work.
halt.translation: Shut down and power off the system.

hdiutil.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
hdiutil.translation: Run the macOS disk image manipulation tool.

hdiutil attach.rationale: Attaches a disk image and mounts its volumes, making the contents accessible.
hdiutil attach.translation: Mount a disk image as a device on the system.

hdiutil burn.rationale: Writes data to physical media, which is not easily reversible for write-once discs.
hdiutil burn.translation: Burn a disk image to optical media.

hdiutil checksum.rationale: Read-only computation that does not modify the image.
hdiutil checksum.translation: Calculate a checksum for a disk image.

hdiutil chpass.rationale: Changes the encryption passphrase; data remains accessible with the new passphrase.
hdiutil chpass.translation: Change the passphrase on an encrypted disk image.

hdiutil compact.rationale: Modifies the disk image file to reduce its size on disk.
hdiutil compact.translation: Reclaim unused space in a sparse disk image.

hdiutil convert.rationale: Creates a new disk image in the target format; the original is preserved unless overwritten.
hdiutil convert.translation: Convert a disk image to a different format.

hdiutil create.rationale: Creates a new disk image file; does not modify existing files unless overwrite is specified.

hdiutil detach.rationale: Unmounts volumes and detaches the device; data in flight may be lost if not flushed.
hdiutil detach.translation: Unmount and disconnect a disk image from the system.

hdiutil erasekeys.rationale: Permanently renders the encrypted data unrecoverable by destroying the keys.
hdiutil erasekeys.translation: Destroy encryption keys for an encrypted disk image, making its data permanently inaccessible.

hdiutil imageinfo.translation: Display detailed properties of a disk image.

hdiutil info.rationale: Read-only display of attached image information.
hdiutil info.translation: Display information about currently attached disk images.

hdiutil isencrypted.rationale: Read-only query that does not modify the image.
hdiutil isencrypted.translation: Check whether a disk image is encrypted.

hdiutil makehybrid.rationale: Creates a new image file; may overwrite an existing file at the output path.
hdiutil makehybrid.translation: Create a hybrid disk image compatible with multiple filesystems.

hdiutil resize.rationale: Changes the size of a disk image, which can cause data loss if shrinking below used capacity.
hdiutil resize.translation: Resize a disk image or its partitions.

hdiutil segment.rationale: Creates new segment files; the original image is preserved.
hdiutil segment.translation: Split a disk image into multiple smaller segment files.

hdiutil verify.rationale: Read-only integrity check that does not modify the image.
hdiutil verify.translation: Verify the checksum of a read-only disk image.

head.rationale: Read-only operation that outputs the beginning of file contents without modifying anything.
head.translation: Display the first lines of a file.

heap.rationale: Read-only inspection of process memory; does not modify the target process.
heap.translation: List all memory allocations in the heap of a running process.

hexdump.rationale: Read-only display of file contents in various formats.
hexdump.translation: Display the contents of a file in hexadecimal, octal, or ASCII format.

host.rationale: Read-only DNS query that modifies nothing.
host.translation: Perform a DNS lookup for a hostname or IP address.

hostname.rationale: Without arguments, only displays the current hostname.
hostname.translation: Display or set the system hostname.

htpasswd.rationale: Modifies password files used for web server authentication.
htpasswd.translation: Create or update Apache HTTP server password files.

httpd.rationale: Starts a network-accessible web server that serves files and executes server-side scripts.
httpd.translation: Run the Apache HTTP web server.

httpx.rationale: Sends HTTP requests and displays responses; does not modify local files by default.
httpx.translation: Send HTTP requests to a URL and display the response.

iconutil.rationale: Creates a new output file; does not modify the source.
iconutil.translation: Convert between icon set folders and icon files.

iconv.rationale: Reads input and writes converted text to the terminal; does not modify files in place.
iconv.translation: Convert text from one character encoding to another.

id.rationale: Read-only display of user identity information.
id.translation: Display the user and group IDs of the current user or a specified user.

ifconfig.rationale: Without arguments, only displays current network interface configuration.
ifconfig.translation: Display or configure network interface parameters.

initdb.rationale: Creates database directories and system tables; does not destroy existing data unless pointed at an occupied directory.
initdb.translation: Create a new PostgreSQL database cluster.

install.rationale: Copies files and can set ownership and permissions; overwrites existing files at the destination.
install.translation: Copy files to a destination while setting permissions and ownership.

install_name_tool.rationale: Modifies the binary in place, changing which libraries it loads at runtime.
install_name_tool.translation: Change the shared library paths stored inside a compiled program.

installer.rationale: Installs system-level software packages that can modify system files, install services, and run scripts.
installer.translation: Install macOS software packages from the command line.

ioreg.rationale: Read-only display of hardware device information; modifies nothing.
ioreg.translation: Display the I/O Kit device registry as a tree.

iostat.rationale: Read-only display of kernel I/O statistics.
iostat.translation: Display disk and CPU I/O statistics.

ipcrm.rationale: Permanently removes shared memory segments, message queues, or synchronization locks that may be in use by running processes.
ipcrm.translation: Remove System V interprocess communication resources.

ipcs.rationale: Read-only display of IPC facility status.
ipcs.translation: Display information about System V interprocess communication resources.

java.rationale: Executes arbitrary compiled Java code, which can modify files, make network requests, or run system commands.
java.translation: Run the Java virtual machine to execute compiled Java programs.

javac.rationale: Compiles source files into class files; does not execute the resulting code.
javac.translation: Compile Java source code into bytecode class files.

jest.rationale: Executes test suites that may have side effects depending on the tests, but the primary purpose is validation.
jest.translation: Run JavaScript and TypeScript tests using the Jest test framework.

join.rationale: Reads two files and writes the joined output to the terminal; does not modify input files.
join.translation: Join lines from two files on a common field.

jot.rationale: Writes generated data to the terminal; does not modify any files.
jot.translation: Generate a sequence of numbers or random data.

jq.rationale: Reads JSON from input or files and writes transformed results to the terminal; does not modify source files.
jq.translation: Process and transform JSON data using filter expressions.

kdestroy.rationale: Destroys authentication tickets, which may require re-authentication for services.
kdestroy.translation: Remove Kerberos credential tickets from the cache.

keytool.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
keytool.translation: Manage cryptographic keys and certificates in a Java keystore.

keytool -certreq.rationale: Creates a request file; does not modify the keystore.
keytool -certreq.translation: Generate a certificate signing request from the keystore.

keytool -delete.rationale: Permanently removes a key or certificate; recovery requires a backup.
keytool -delete.translation: Delete an entry from the keystore.

keytool -exportcert.rationale: Reads from the keystore and writes to a file; the keystore is not modified.
keytool -exportcert.translation: Export a certificate from the keystore to a file.

keytool -genkeypair.rationale: Creates a persistent key pair used for authentication and signing.
keytool -genkeypair.translation: Generate a new key pair and store it in the keystore.

keytool -importcert.rationale: Adds a trusted certificate that affects which connections and code are trusted.
keytool -importcert.translation: Import a certificate into the keystore.

keytool -importkeystore.rationale: Copies keys and certificates into the destination keystore; may overwrite existing entries.
keytool -importkeystore.translation: Import all entries from one keystore into another.

keytool -keypasswd.rationale: Alters the key's encryption password; forgetting the new password locks out the key.
keytool -keypasswd.translation: Change the password protecting a specific key entry.

keytool -printcert.translation: Display the contents of a certificate file.

keytool -storepasswd.rationale: Alters the keystore encryption password; forgetting the new password locks out access.
keytool -storepasswd.translation: Change the password of the keystore.

kill.rationale: Terminates or signals a specific process by ID, which may interrupt important work or cause data loss.
kill.translation: Send a signal to one or more running processes, typically to stop them.

killall.rationale: Terminates all processes with the given name, which may include unintended processes.
killall.translation: Send a signal to all processes matching a name.

kinit.rationale: Acquires authentication credentials; does not modify any services or data.

klist.rationale: Read-only display of cached authentication tickets.
klist.translation: Display the contents of a Kerberos credential cache.

kswitch.rationale: Changes which credential cache is the default; does not create or destroy credentials.

kubectl.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

kubectl annotate.rationale: Modifies metadata annotations, which are informational and typically not used for scheduling.
kubectl annotate.translation: Add or update annotations on a Kubernetes resource.

kubectl api-resources.rationale: Read-only display of available API resources.
kubectl api-resources.translation: List the resource types available in the Kubernetes cluster.

kubectl apply.rationale: Modifies live cluster resources to match the declared state.
kubectl apply.translation: Create or update Kubernetes resources to match a configuration file.

kubectl attach.rationale: Connects to the container's main process; input may affect a running application.
kubectl attach.translation: Attach to a running process inside a container in a pod.

kubectl auth.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
kubectl auth.translation: Inspect authorization settings in the cluster.

kubectl auth can-i.rationale: Read-only authorization check that does not modify any resources.
kubectl auth can-i.translation: Check whether a specific action is allowed for the current user.

kubectl cluster-info.rationale: Read-only display of cluster endpoint information.
kubectl cluster-info.translation: Display the addresses of the control plane and cluster services.

kubectl config.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
kubectl config.translation: View or modify the kubeconfig file that controls cluster access.

kubectl config current-context.rationale: Read-only display of the current context.
kubectl config current-context.translation: Display the name of the currently active cluster context.

kubectl config delete-context.rationale: Deletes a cluster context reference; the cluster itself is not affected.
kubectl config delete-context.translation: Remove a context entry from the kubeconfig file.

kubectl config use-context.rationale: Changes which cluster subsequent commands target; running commands against the wrong cluster can be dangerous.
kubectl config use-context.translation: Switch the active cluster context in the kubeconfig file.

kubectl config view.rationale: Read-only display of configuration; secrets may be shown unless redacted.

kubectl cordon.rationale: Prevents new workloads from running on the node; existing pods are not affected.
kubectl cordon.translation: Mark a node as unschedulable so no new pods will be placed on it.

kubectl cp.rationale: Transfers files into or out of a running container, which could modify application state or exfiltrate data.
kubectl cp.translation: Copy files between a local filesystem and a container in a pod.

kubectl create.rationale: Adds new resources to the cluster such as pods, deployments, or services.
kubectl create.translation: Create a Kubernetes resource from a file or command-line input.

kubectl debug.rationale: Creates a temporary debugging container with potential access to the pod's filesystem and network.
kubectl debug.translation: Create a debugging container attached to a running pod or node.

kubectl delete.rationale: Permanently removes resources; pods, services, and deployments are destroyed.
kubectl delete.translation: Remove one or more resources from the Kubernetes cluster.

kubectl describe.rationale: Read-only display of resource details and events.
kubectl describe.translation: Show detailed information about a specific Kubernetes resource.

kubectl diff.rationale: Read-only comparison that does not modify any resources.
kubectl diff.translation: Show the differences between the current live resource and a proposed configuration.

kubectl drain.rationale: Removes all workloads from a node, causing service disruption if insufficient capacity exists elsewhere.
kubectl drain.translation: Evict all pods from a node to prepare it for maintenance.

kubectl edit.rationale: Directly modifies live resources; changes take effect immediately on save.
kubectl edit.translation: Open a Kubernetes resource in a text editor for live modification.

kubectl events.translation: List events from the Kubernetes cluster.

kubectl exec.rationale: Executes arbitrary commands inside a live container, which could modify application state.
kubectl exec.translation: Run a command inside a container in a running pod.

kubectl expose.rationale: Makes a workload accessible over the network, potentially exposing it to external traffic.
kubectl expose.translation: Create a new service to expose a running application to network traffic.

kubectl get.rationale: Read-only query that lists resource information.
kubectl get.translation: Display one or more Kubernetes resources in a summary table.

kubectl label.rationale: Labels can affect service routing, scheduling, and policy enforcement; incorrect labels may disrupt traffic.
kubectl label.translation: Add or update labels on a Kubernetes resource.

kubectl logs.translation: Print the log output from a container in a pod.

kubectl patch.rationale: Modifies live resources; changes take effect immediately.
kubectl patch.translation: Update specific fields of a Kubernetes resource using a partial specification.

kubectl port-forward.rationale: Exposes a cluster-internal service to the local machine, bypassing normal network access controls.
kubectl port-forward.translation: Forward a local port to a port on a pod or service.

kubectl proxy.rationale: Exposes the full Kubernetes API on localhost without authentication, allowing any local process to make API calls.
kubectl proxy.translation: Start a local proxy to the Kubernetes API server.

kubectl replace.rationale: Completely replaces the resource specification, which may remove fields or settings not in the new definition.
kubectl replace.translation: Replace a Kubernetes resource with a new definition from a file.

kubectl rollout.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
kubectl rollout.translation: Manage the rollout of a deployment, daemonset, or statefulset.

kubectl rollout history.rationale: Read-only display of past rollout revisions.
kubectl rollout history.translation: View the revision history of a rollout.

kubectl rollout pause.rationale: Halts rollout progress; the workload may be left in a partially updated state.
kubectl rollout pause.translation: Pause the rollout of a resource to prevent further updates.

kubectl rollout restart.rationale: Restarts all pods in the workload, causing brief unavailability if not enough replicas exist.
kubectl rollout restart.translation: Trigger a rolling restart of a deployment, daemonset, or statefulset.

kubectl rollout resume.rationale: Resumes a previously paused rollout, applying pending changes to the workload.
kubectl rollout resume.translation: Resume a paused rollout so updates continue.

kubectl rollout status.translation: Show the current status of a rollout.

kubectl rollout undo.rationale: Reverts to a previous version; reversible by rolling forward again. Standard recovery operation.
kubectl rollout undo.translation: Roll back a deployment, daemonset, or statefulset to a previous revision.

kubectl run.rationale: Creates a new pod that consumes cluster resources and runs arbitrary container images.
kubectl run.translation: Create and run a pod with a specified container image.

kubectl scale.rationale: Changing replica count directly affects application capacity and availability.
kubectl scale.translation: Change the number of replicas for a deployment, replica set, or stateful set.

kubectl taint.rationale: Taints affect pod scheduling across the cluster; incorrect taints can prevent workloads from running.
kubectl taint.translation: Add or remove a taint on a node to control which pods can be scheduled on it.

kubectl top.rationale: Read-only metrics query from the Metrics Server.
kubectl top.translation: Display CPU and memory usage for nodes or pods.

kubectl uncordon.rationale: Restores normal scheduling to a previously cordoned node.
kubectl uncordon.translation: Mark a node as schedulable so new pods can be placed on it again.

kubectl wait.rationale: Read-only polling operation that blocks until a condition is met.
kubectl wait.translation: Wait for a specific condition on one or more Kubernetes resources.

last.rationale: Read-only query of the login history database.
last.translation: Display a list of previous user login sessions.

latency.rationale: Read-only monitoring of system timing behavior; requires root privileges but modifies nothing.
latency.translation: Monitor scheduling and interrupt latency statistics in real time.

launchctl.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
launchctl.translation: Run the macOS service management tool.

launchctl blame.rationale: Read-only display of the reason a service is running.
launchctl blame.translation: Show why a service was started.

launchctl bootout.rationale: Stops and unregisters a running service, which may interrupt dependent processes.
launchctl bootout.translation: Stop and remove a registered service.

launchctl bootstrap.rationale: Registers and may start a system or user service.
launchctl bootstrap.translation: Load and register a service so it can run.

launchctl config.rationale: Changes system-wide service manager settings that persist across restarts and require a reboot to take effect.
launchctl config.translation: Set persistent configuration for the service manager.

launchctl disable.rationale: Blocks a service from running, which may affect system functionality; the change persists across restarts.
launchctl disable.translation: Prevent a service from starting automatically.

launchctl dumpstate.translation: Display the complete internal state of the service manager.

launchctl enable.rationale: Enables a service to run on demand or at startup; the change persists across restarts.
launchctl enable.translation: Allow a service to start automatically.

launchctl error.translation: Display a human-readable description of an error code.

launchctl kickstart.rationale: Starts a service outside its normal trigger conditions.
launchctl kickstart.translation: Force a service to start immediately.

launchctl kill.rationale: May terminate the service process, interrupting whatever it was doing.
launchctl kill.translation: Send a signal to a running service's process.
