launchctl limit.rationale: Changing resource limits may affect system stability or service behavior.
launchctl limit.translation: View or set system resource limits for services.

launchctl load.rationale: Registers and may start a service; this command is deprecated in favor of bootstrap.
launchctl load.translation: Load a service configuration file so the service can run.

launchctl print.rationale: Read-only display of service status and configuration.
launchctl print.translation: Display detailed information about a service or service domain.

launchctl reboot.rationale: Restarts the entire system, interrupting all running processes and unsaved work.

launchctl remove.rationale: Unregisters a service, which prevents it from running until reloaded.
launchctl remove.translation: Remove a service by its label.

launchctl start.rationale: Manually starts a service, which may launch arbitrary processes.
launchctl start.translation: Start a service by its label.

launchctl stop.rationale: Stops a running service, which may interrupt dependent processes.
launchctl stop.translation: Stop a service by its label.

launchctl unload.rationale: Stops and deregisters a service; this command is deprecated in favor of bootout.
launchctl unload.translation: Unload a service configuration file, stopping the service.

ld.rationale: Produces output files from object files; does not execute the result.
ld.translation: Link object files and libraries into an executable or library.

ldapadd.rationale: Creates new entries in a directory server, which could affect authentication or access control if misapplied.
ldapadd.translation: Add new entries to an LDAP directory.

ldapdelete.rationale: Permanently removes directory entries, which can affect authentication and access control for users and services.
ldapdelete.translation: Delete entries from an LDAP directory.

ldapmodify.rationale: Changes attributes on directory entries, which can affect authentication, access control, or organizational data.
ldapmodify.translation: Modify existing entries in an LDAP directory.

ldapsearch.rationale: Read-only search against an LDAP directory server.
ldapsearch.translation: Search an LDAP directory and display matching entries.

ldapwhoami.rationale: Read-only operation that only reports the authenticated identity.
ldapwhoami.translation: Display the identity of the current LDAP connection.

leaks.rationale: Read-only inspection of process memory; does not modify the target process.
leaks.translation: Search a process's memory for unreferenced allocations that can never be freed.

less.rationale: Read-only pager that displays file contents interactively.
less.translation: View file contents one screen at a time.

link.rationale: Creates a new directory entry pointing to an existing file's data, making the file accessible from multiple paths.
link.translation: Create a hard link between two files.

lipo.rationale: Without a command, only displays architecture information from input files.
lipo.translation: Create or manipulate universal (multi-architecture) binary files.

lldb.rationale: Can attach to running processes, inspect memory, and modify program state.
lldb.translation: Run the LLVM debugger for inspecting and debugging programs.

ln.rationale: Creates a new directory entry pointing to an existing file; does not modify the original.
ln.translation: Create a link that points to an existing file, so the same file can be accessed from multiple locations.

locale.rationale: Read-only display of locale configuration; modifies nothing.
locale.translation: Display the current language and regional settings.

locate.rationale: Read-only search of the locate database; does not modify any files.
locate.translation: Search a pre-built database for files matching a pattern.

log.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
log.translation: Access the macOS unified logging system.

log collect.rationale: Creates a copy of log data; does not modify the original logs.
log collect.translation: Gather system logs into an archive file for later analysis.

log config.rationale: Modifies which log messages are captured or retained, which can affect debugging and auditing.
log config.translation: Change the logging level or persistence settings for the system or a specific process.

log erase.rationale: Permanently removes log entries, destroying diagnostic and audit information.
log erase.translation: Delete log data from the system.

log show.rationale: Read-only display of stored log entries; modifies nothing.
log show.translation: Display log messages from the system log or a log archive.

log stats.rationale: Read-only analysis of log storage; modifies nothing.
log stats.translation: Display a statistical breakdown of log data.

log stream.rationale: Read-only monitoring of live log entries; modifies nothing.
log stream.translation: Watch new log messages in real time.

logger.rationale: Adds an entry to the system log; does not modify files or processes.
logger.translation: Write a message to the system log.

login.rationale: Authenticates a user and starts a shell session with that user's privileges.
login.translation: Start a new login session on the system.

logname.rationale: Read-only display of the login name.
logname.translation: Display the current user's login name.

logout.rationale: Exits the current shell session; no data is destroyed and a new session can be started immediately.

look.rationale: Read-only search that writes matching lines to the terminal.
look.translation: Display lines in a sorted file that begin with a given string.

lp.rationale: Submits a print job; the original file is not modified.
lp.translation: Send a file to a printer for printing.

lpadmin.rationale: Modifies the print system configuration, adding, removing, or changing printers.
lpadmin.translation: Configure CUPS printers and printer classes.

lpq.rationale: Read-only display of queued print jobs.
lpq.translation: Display the status of a printer queue.

lpr.rationale: Submits a print job; the original file is not modified.
lpr.translation: Send files to a printer for printing.

lprm.rationale: Removes print jobs from the queue; the job must be resubmitted if still needed.

lpstat.rationale: Read-only display of printer and job status.
lpstat.translation: Display the status of printers and print jobs.

ls.rationale: Read-only operation that displays file and directory names without modifying anything.
ls.translation: List the contents of a directory.

lsof.rationale: Read-only listing of open files, network connections, and associated processes.
lsof.translation: List open files and the processes that opened them.

lz4.rationale: By default replaces source files with compressed or decompressed versions.
lz4.translation: Compress or decompress files using the LZ4 algorithm.

lzma.rationale: By default replaces source files with compressed versions, removing the originals.
lzma.translation: Compress or decompress files using the Lempel-Ziv-Markov algorithm.

m4.rationale: Reads input, expands macros, and writes to the terminal; does not modify files in place.
m4.translation: Process text through a macro expansion engine.

mail.rationale: Can send email to external recipients and modify local mailbox files.
mail.translation: Send and receive email messages from the command line.

mailq.rationale: Read-only listing of queued mail messages and their delivery status.
mailq.translation: Display the contents of the mail queue.

make.rationale: Executes arbitrary shell commands defined in the Makefile, which may modify files or run programs.
make.translation: Build targets by running commands defined in a Makefile.

make clean.rationale: Executes the Makefile's clean target, which typically deletes compiled outputs and temporary files.
make clean.translation: Remove build artifacts and generated files by running the clean target.

man.translation: Display the manual page for a command or topic.

mas.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
mas.translation: Run the Mac App Store command-line interface.

mas install.rationale: Downloads and installs applications, which consume disk space and may run background processes.
mas install.translation: Install previously purchased apps from the Mac App Store.

mas list.translation: List all apps installed from the Mac App Store.

mas outdated.translation: List apps with pending updates from the Mac App Store.

mas reset.rationale: Terminates App Store processes and deletes cached data.
mas reset.translation: Reset App Store processes and clear cached downloads.

mas search.rationale: Read-only operation that searches the Mac App Store without installing or modifying anything.
mas search.translation: Search for apps in the Mac App Store.

mas signout.rationale: Ends the current App Store session, requiring re-authentication for future purchases.
mas signout.translation: Sign out of the Mac App Store.

mas uninstall.rationale: Permanently removes an application and its associated data.
mas uninstall.translation: Uninstall apps that were installed from the Mac App Store.

mas upgrade.rationale: Downloads and installs new versions of multiple apps, which may introduce breaking changes.
mas upgrade.translation: Update all outdated apps from the Mac App Store.

md5.rationale: Read-only computation that produces a hash digest without modifying files.
md5.translation: Calculate an MD5 checksum for files or strings.

mdfind.rationale: Read-only search of the Spotlight index; does not modify any files.
mdfind.translation: Search for files using the macOS Spotlight metadata index.

mdimport.rationale: Triggers re-indexing of files for Spotlight search; does not modify file contents.
mdimport.translation: Import files into the macOS Spotlight metadata index.

mdls.translation: Display the Spotlight metadata attributes for a file.

mdutil.rationale: Can enable, disable, or erase the Spotlight index on volumes.
mdutil.translation: Manage the macOS Spotlight metadata index for mounted volumes.

mesg.rationale: Only changes the write permission on the terminal device.
mesg.translation: Control whether other users can send messages to your terminal.

mig.rationale: Generates source code files locally; does not modify system state or running services.
mig.translation: Generate remote procedure call code for Mach inter-process communication from a specification file.

mkbom.rationale: Generates a metadata file; overwrites only the specified output bom file.
mkbom.translation: Create a bill-of-materials file from a directory or file listing.

mkbundle.rationale: Generates a compiled output file locally; does not modify existing files or system state.
mkbundle.translation: Bundle Mono assemblies and dependencies into a standalone executable.

mkdir.rationale: Creates empty directories; does not modify or overwrite existing files or directories.

mkextunpack.rationale: Reads an archive and extracts files to a specified directory; does not modify system state.
mkextunpack.translation: Extract or list the contents of a kernel extension archive file.

mkfifo.rationale: Creates a special file entry; trivially removable with rm.
mkfifo.translation: Create a named pipe (named pipe special file) in the filesystem.

mkfile.rationale: Creates files that can consume significant disk space; overwrites any existing file at the target path.
mkfile.translation: Create a file of a specified size, padded with zeroes.

mknod.rationale: Creates device nodes that interact with kernel drivers; incorrect usage could affect device access.
mknod.translation: Create a device special file or named pipe in the filesystem.

mkpassdb.rationale: Directly manipulates the authentication database; incorrect changes can lock out users or compromise security.
mkpassdb.translation: Create or modify the macOS Server password server database.

mkpassdb --deleteslot.rationale: Permanently removes a user's authentication entry from the database.
mkpassdb --deleteslot.translation: Invalidate a user slot in the password server database.

mkpassdb --dump.translation: Display all user IDs and names stored in the password server database.

mkpassdb --header.translation: Display the password server database header information.

mkpassdb --key.rationale: Read-only display of the public key.
mkpassdb --key.translation: Display the RSA public key stored in the password server database.

mkpassdb --list.rationale: Read-only listing that does not require root.
mkpassdb --list.translation: List all supported authentication methods available to the password server.

mkpassdb --mergedb.rationale: Overwrites authentication entries in the live database, which can disrupt user access.
mkpassdb --mergedb.translation: Merge a snapshot of a password server database into the current database.

mkpassdb --rekeydb.rationale: Replaces encryption keys; existing users will not be able to authenticate until reconfigured.
mkpassdb --rekeydb.translation: Generate a new RSA key pair for the password server database.

mkpassdb --setadmin.rationale: Grants elevated privileges that allow full control over the password server.
mkpassdb --setadmin.translation: Promote a user slot to administrator privileges in the password server.

mkpassdb --setglobalpolicy.rationale: Changes authentication policies server-wide, potentially locking out users who do not meet the new policy.
mkpassdb --setglobalpolicy.translation: Set the default password policies for all users on the password server.

mktemp.rationale: Creates a small temporary file in a temp directory; trivially removable.
mktemp.translation: Create a temporary file or directory with a unique name.

ml-antlr.rationale: Generates source code files locally; does not modify system state.
ml-antlr.translation: Generate a predictive parser in Standard ML from a grammar specification file.

ml-build.rationale: Compiles source code into a local heap image; does not modify system state.
ml-build.translation: Build a Standard ML program into a heap image using the Standard ML of New Jersey Compilation Manager.

ml-burg.rationale: Generates source code files locally; does not modify system state.
ml-burg.translation: Generate a bottom-up tree rewriting program in Standard ML from a specification file.

ml-lex.rationale: Generates source code files locally; does not modify system state.
ml-lex.translation: Generate a lexical scanner in Standard ML from a specification file.

ml-makedepend.rationale: Appends dependency information to a makefile; does not compile or run code.
ml-makedepend.translation: Generate makefile dependency information for a Standard ML project.

ml-ulex.rationale: Generates source code files locally; does not modify system state.
ml-ulex.translation: Generate a Unicode-aware lexical scanner in Standard ML from a specification file.

ml-yacc.rationale: Generates source code files locally; does not modify system state.
ml-yacc.translation: Generate a table-driven parser in Standard ML from a grammar specification file.

mnthome.rationale: Unmounts and remounts a network filesystem, which temporarily disrupts access to the home directory.
mnthome.translation: Unmount and remount an AFP home directory with the correct user privileges.

mod-mono-server.rationale: Starts a network-facing web server that serves ASP.NET applications.
mod-mono-server.translation: Run an embedded ASP.NET web server for use with the Apache mod_mono module.

mod-mono-server2.rationale: Starts a network-facing web server that serves ASP.NET applications.
mod-mono-server2.translation: Run an embedded ASP.NET web server for use with the Apache mod_mono module.

mod-mono-server4.rationale: Starts a network-facing web server that serves ASP.NET applications.
mod-mono-server4.translation: Run an embedded ASP.NET web server for use with the Apache mod_mono module.

mongosh.rationale: Connects to a live database where any command can be executed, including destructive operations like dropDatabase.

mono.rationale: Executes arbitrary managed code, which could modify files or system state.
mono.translation: Run a .NET application using the Mono runtime.

mono-api-html.rationale: Read-only comparison of XML files; produces only a report.
mono-api-html.translation: Generate an HTML or Markdown report showing differences between two Mono API snapshots.

mono-api-info.rationale: Read-only inspection of assembly metadata; produces only XML output.
mono-api-info.translation: Extract the public API structure of a .NET assembly as XML.

mono-cil-strip.rationale: Modifies an assembly file by emptying method bodies; the original is overwritten unless an output file is specified.
mono-cil-strip.translation: Remove method bodies from a .NET assembly, keeping only metadata.

mono-configuration-crypto.rationale: Creates, imports, exports, or removes cryptographic keys that protect configuration data.
mono-configuration-crypto.translation: Manage encryption keys and encrypt or decrypt .NET configuration file sections.

mono-service.rationale: Starts a long-running background process that may modify system state or listen on network ports.
mono-service.translation: Run a .NET service application as a background background service using the Mono runtime.

mono-service2.rationale: Starts a long-running background process that may modify system state or listen on network ports.
mono-service2.translation: Run a .NET 2.0 service application as a background background service using the Mono runtime.

mono-sgen.rationale: Executes arbitrary managed code, which could modify files or system state.
mono-sgen.translation: Run a .NET application using the Mono runtime with the SGen garbage collector.

mono-shlib-cop.rationale: Read-only analysis of assembly metadata; produces only diagnostic output.
mono-shlib-cop.translation: Check a .NET assembly for incorrect or suspicious shared library references.

mono-symbolicate.rationale: Read-only transformation of stack trace text; produces only symbolicated output.
mono-symbolicate.translation: Replace memory addresses in a Mono stack trace with source file names and line numbers.

mono-xmltool.rationale: Read-only validation and transformation of XML files; output is written to the terminal or a specified file.
mono-xmltool.translation: Validate or transform XML documents using schemas, stylesheets, or grammars.

mono32.rationale: Executes arbitrary managed code in 32-bit mode, which could modify files or system state.
mono32.translation: Run a .NET application using the Mono runtime in 32-bit mode.

mono64.rationale: Executes arbitrary managed code in 64-bit mode, which could modify files or system state.
mono64.translation: Run a .NET application using the Mono runtime in 64-bit mode.

monodis.rationale: Read-only disassembly of assembly metadata and code; produces only text output.
monodis.translation: Disassemble a .NET assembly into human-readable Common Intermediate Language text.

monodocer.rationale: Creates or updates local documentation XML files; does not modify the assembly.
monodocer.translation: Generate or update XML documentation files from .NET assembly metadata.

monodocs2html.rationale: Generates HTML files from documentation sources; does not modify the source documentation.
monodocs2html.translation: Export Mono XML documentation to HTML files.

monodocs2slashdoc.rationale: Generates XML files from documentation sources; does not modify the source documentation.
monodocs2slashdoc.translation: Export Mono XML documentation into Microsoft XML Documentation format.

monolinker.rationale: Produces stripped copies of assemblies; incorrect configuration can remove needed code.
monolinker.translation: Remove unused types and methods from .NET assemblies to reduce their size.

monop.rationale: Read-only inspection of assembly types; produces only text output.
monop.translation: Display the public members and definition of a .NET type or assembly.

more.rationale: Read-only display of file contents; modifies nothing.
more.translation: Display file contents one screen at a time in the terminal.

mount.rationale: Attaching a volume changes the directory structure visible to all programs; with no arguments it is read-only.
mount.translation: Attach a storage volume to the directory tree, or list all currently attached volumes.

mount_9p.rationale: Attaches a network filesystem to the local directory tree, changing the directory tree for all processes.

mount_acfs.rationale: Attaches a filesystem to the local directory tree, changing the directory tree for all processes.
mount_acfs.translation: Mount an Apple Cluster File System volume.

mount_afp.rationale: Attaches a remote network share to the local directory tree.
mount_afp.translation: Mount an AFP network share from an AppleShare file server.

mount_apfs.rationale: Attaches a local APFS volume to the directory tree, changing the directory tree for all processes.
mount_apfs.translation: Mount an APFS volume to the filesystem.

mount_cd9660.rationale: Mounts a read-only optical disc filesystem; no data can be modified.
mount_cd9660.translation: Mount an ISO 9660 compact disc filesystem.

mount_cddafs.rationale: Mounts a read-only audio CD filesystem; no data can be modified.
mount_cddafs.translation: Mount a CD Digital Audio filesystem for accessing audio tracks as files.

mount_exfat.rationale: Attaches a read-write filesystem to the directory tree; files on the volume can be modified.

mount_fdesc.rationale: Mounts a virtual filesystem that provides access to open file references; no real data is modified.
mount_fdesc.translation: Mount the open file reference pseudo-filesystem.

mount_ftp.rationale: Provides read-only access to files on a remote FTP server.
mount_ftp.translation: Mount an FTP server as a read-only filesystem.

mount_hfs.rationale: Attaches a read-write filesystem to the directory tree; files on the volume can be modified.
mount_hfs.translation: Mount an HFS or HFS Plus filesystem.

mount_msdos.rationale: Attaches a read-write filesystem to the directory tree; files on the volume can be modified.
mount_msdos.translation: Mount a FAT12, FAT16, or FAT32 filesystem.

mount_nfs.rationale: Attaches a remote network filesystem to the local directory tree, enabling read-write access by default.
mount_nfs.translation: Mount a remote NFS network filesystem.

mount_smbfs.rationale: Attaches a remote network share to the local directory tree, enabling read-write access by default.
mount_smbfs.translation: Mount a shared folder from an SMB file server.

mount_tmpfs.rationale: Creates a read-write filesystem in memory; data is lost on unmount or reboot.

mount_udf.rationale: Typically mounts optical media in read-only mode.
mount_udf.translation: Mount a Universal Disk Format filesystem from a disc or image.

mount_virtiofs.rationale: Attaches a shared filesystem that bridges host and guest; changes are visible to both.
mount_virtiofs.translation: Mount a VirtIO shared filesystem between a virtual machine and its host.

mount_webdav.rationale: Attaches a remote WebDAV share to the local directory tree, enabling read-write access.
mount_webdav.translation: Mount a WebDAV server as a filesystem.

mozroots.rationale: Modifies the local certificate trust store, which affects TLS validation for all Mono applications.
mozroots.translation: Download and import trusted root certificates from Mozilla into the Mono trust store.

mp2bug.rationale: Collects system information and prints a template; does not modify anything.
mp2bug.translation: Generate a mod_perl bug report template with system information.

mpioutil.rationale: The bare command prints help text.
mpioutil.translation: Manage multiple paths to storage device logical units.

mpioutil info.translation: Display information about a multipathed logical unit.

mpioutil list.rationale: Read-only listing of multipath storage devices.

mpioutil modify lun.rationale: Changes how I/O is distributed across paths, which can affect storage performance.
mpioutil modify lun.translation: Change the load-balancing algorithm for a multipathed logical unit.

mpioutil modify path.rationale: Disabling a path reduces redundancy; enabling restores it.
mpioutil modify path.translation: Enable or disable a specific path to a multipathed logical unit.

mprof-report.rationale: Read-only analysis of a profiler log; produces only text output.
mprof-report.translation: Generate a human-readable report from a Mono profiler log file.

msbuild.rationale: Compiles source code and produces build artifacts locally; does not deploy or modify production systems.
msbuild.translation: Build a project or solution using the MSBuild build engine.

msgattrib.rationale: Processes PO files and writes filtered output; source files are not modified unless redirected.
msgattrib.translation: Filter and modify the attributes of messages in a translation catalog file.

msgcat.rationale: Combines PO files and writes merged output; source files are not modified.
msgcat.translation: Concatenate and merge multiple translation catalog files.

msgcmp.rationale: Read-only comparison that produces diagnostic output.
msgcmp.translation: Compare two translation catalog files for consistency.

msgcomm.rationale: Read-only extraction that outputs common messages.
msgcomm.translation: Find messages common to two or more translation catalog files.

msgconv.rationale: Converts encoding and writes to the terminal or a file; source file is not modified.
msgconv.translation: Convert a translation catalog file to a different character encoding.

msgen.rationale: Generates a PO file with identity translations; source file is not modified.
msgen.translation: Create an English translation catalog by copying source strings as translations.

msgexec.rationale: Executes an arbitrary shell command for each message, which could modify system state.
msgexec.translation: Apply a shell command to each translation in a catalog file.

msgfilter.rationale: Executes an arbitrary filter command for each translation string.
msgfilter.translation: Apply a text filter command to all translations in a catalog file.

msgfmt.rationale: Generates a binary message catalog file; source files are not modified.
msgfmt.translation: Compile a translation catalog from a text PO file into a binary machine object file.

msggrep.rationale: Read-only search that outputs matching messages.
msggrep.translation: Search for messages matching a pattern in a translation catalog file.

msginit.rationale: Generates a new PO file from a template; does not modify existing translations.
msginit.translation: Create a new translation catalog file from a PO template.

msgmerge.rationale: Combines translations with a new template; writes to the terminal unless --update is used.
msgmerge.translation: Merge existing translations with an updated PO template file.

msgpre.rationale: Processes PO files and writes output; source files are not modified.

msgunfmt.rationale: Read-only decompilation of a binary file; writes to the terminal or a specified output file.
msgunfmt.translation: Convert a binary machine object message catalog back into a readable PO text file.

msguniq.rationale: Deduplicates a PO file and writes to the terminal or a specified output file.
msguniq.translation: Remove duplicate messages from a translation catalog file.

mtree.rationale: By default, compares a directory to a specification and reports differences; read-only.
mtree.translation: Compare a directory hierarchy against a specification or generate a specification from a directory.

mv.rationale: Relocates files, removing them from the original location; silently overwrites the destination by default.
mv.translation: Move or rename files and directories.

mysql.rationale: Connects to a live database where any SQL statement can be executed, including destructive operations.

nano.rationale: Opens files for editing; changes are written when the user saves.
nano.translation: Open a file in the nano text editor.

nbdst.rationale: Modifies the root device's write path; incorrect usage could affect the boot environment.
nbdst.translation: Associate a shadow file with a NetBoot root disk image for local write redirection.

nc.rationale: Opens arbitrary network connections that can send and receive data.
nc.translation: Read and write data across network connections.

ncal.rationale: Read-only display of calendar information; modifies nothing.
ncal.translation: Display a calendar in a compact format.

ncctl.rationale: The bare command prints help text.
ncctl.translation: Manage Kerberos credentials for NFS filesystem mounts.

ncctl destroy.rationale: Invalidates NFS authentication credentials, which may cause access failures.
ncctl destroy.translation: Remove the current Kerberos credentials from NFS mounts.

ncctl init.rationale: Changes which Kerberos identity is used for NFS access, affecting file permissions.
ncctl init.translation: Set the Kerberos principal for NFS mounts to use for authentication.

ncctl list.translation: List the Kerberos principals currently set on NFS mounts.

ncdestroy.rationale: Invalidates NFS authentication credentials, which may cause access failures.
ncdestroy.translation: Remove the current Kerberos credentials from NFS mounts.

ncinit.rationale: Changes which Kerberos identity is used for NFS access, affecting file permissions.
ncinit.translation: Set the Kerberos principal for NFS mounts to use for authentication.

nclist.translation: List the Kerberos principals currently set on NFS mounts.

ncurses5.4-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values; modifies nothing.
ncurses5.4-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags needed to build applications against ncurses.

ndp.rationale: The bare command prints help text.
ndp.translation: Control and diagnose the IPv6 Neighbor Discovery Protocol cache.

net-server.rationale: Starts a network-facing server process that listens for and handles connections.
net-server.translation: Start a Perl network server using the Net::Server framework.

net-server5.34.rationale: Starts a network-facing server process that listens for and handles connections.
net-server5.34.translation: Start a Perl network server using the Net::Server framework with Perl 5.34.

net-snmp-cert.rationale: Creates, imports, and manages certificates that control SNMP authentication and encryption.
net-snmp-cert.translation: Manage TLS certificates for Net-SNMP secure communications.

net-snmp-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values; modifies nothing.
net-snmp-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags needed to build applications against Net-SNMP.

net-snmp-create-v3-user.rationale: Modifies the SNMP configuration to add a user with authentication credentials.
net-snmp-create-v3-user.translation: Create a new SNMPv3 user in the Net-SNMP configuration file.

netbiosd.rationale: Starts a network background service that registers and defends NetBIOS names on the local network.
netbiosd.translation: Run the NetBIOS name service background service for network browsing and name registration.

netstat.rationale: Read-only display of network status information; modifies nothing.
netstat.translation: Display network connections, routing tables, interface statistics, and protocol information.

nettop.rationale: Read-only monitoring of network connections; modifies nothing.
nettop.translation: Display a live-updating view of network connection and route activity.

networkQuality.rationale: Performs network measurements using data transfers; does not modify system configuration.
networkQuality.translation: Measure network speed, latency, and responsiveness by running tests against an Internet server.

networksetup.rationale: Can change IP addresses, DNS servers, proxies, and other network settings that affect connectivity.
networksetup.translation: View or modify macOS network configuration settings.

newaliases.rationale: Modifies the mail alias database, which affects how email is routed on the system.
newaliases.translation: Rebuild the Postfix mail alias database from the aliases file.

newfs_apfs.rationale: Formats a device as APFS, destroying all existing data on the partition.
newfs_apfs.translation: Create a new APFS container or add a volume to an existing APFS container.

newfs_exfat.rationale: Formats a device, destroying all existing data on the partition.
newfs_exfat.translation: Create a new exFAT filesystem on a device.

newfs_fskit.rationale: Formats a device, destroying all existing data on the partition.
newfs_fskit.translation: Create a new filesystem using an FSKit filesystem module.

newfs_hfs.rationale: Formats a device, destroying all existing data on the partition.
newfs_hfs.translation: Create a new HFS Plus filesystem on a device.

newfs_msdos.rationale: Formats a device, destroying all existing data on the partition.
newfs_msdos.translation: Create a new FAT12, FAT16, or FAT32 filesystem on a device.

newfs_udf.rationale: Formats a device, destroying all existing data on the partition.
newfs_udf.translation: Create a new Universal Disk Format filesystem on a device.

newgrp.rationale: Changes the effective group for the new shell session; the original session is unaffected.
newgrp.translation: Start a new shell session with a different group identity.

newproc.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of process creation events; does not modify system state.
newproc.d.translation: Trace new processes as they are created on the system using DTrace.

newsyslog.rationale: Archives and truncates log files, which may remove recent log data if misconfigured.
newsyslog.translation: Rotate, compress, and manage system log files to keep them at manageable sizes.

nfs4mapid.rationale: Provides name-to-ID translation for NFSv4; does not modify files or exports.
nfs4mapid.translation: Run the NFSv4 user and group ID mapping service.

nfsd.rationale: Starts a network service that exposes local files to remote clients based on the exports configuration.
nfsd.translation: Run the NFS server background service to serve files to network clients.

nfsd checkexports.rationale: Read-only validation that does not modify the running configuration.
nfsd checkexports.translation: Validate the NFS exports file for syntax errors.

nfsd disable.rationale: Stops the NFS service from auto-starting; a safe shutdown operation.
nfsd disable.translation: Disable the NFS server from starting automatically on boot.

nfsd enable.rationale: Configures the NFS server to persist across reboots, exposing exports continuously.
nfsd enable.translation: Enable the NFS server to start automatically on boot.

nfsd stop.rationale: Interrupts active NFS client connections, which may disrupt remote file access.
nfsd stop.translation: Stop the currently running NFS server.

nfsd update.rationale: Changes which directories are shared; new exports take effect immediately.
nfsd update.translation: Reload the NFS exports configuration without restarting the server.

nfsiod.rationale: A helper background service for NFS performance; does not expose or modify files.
nfsiod.translation: Run the NFS asynchronous I/O server to handle background read-ahead and write-behind requests.

nfsstat.rationale: Read-only display of NFS protocol statistics.
nfsstat.translation: Display NFS client and server activity statistics.

ngettext.rationale: Read-only translation lookup; produces only text output.
ngettext.translation: Look up the correct plural form of a translated message based on a count.

nice.rationale: Changes the priority of a single process; does not affect system stability.
nice.translation: Run a command with an adjusted scheduling priority.

nl.rationale: Read-only filter that adds line numbers; does not modify the input file.
nl.translation: Add line numbers to the output of a file.

nlcontrol.rationale: The bare command prints help text.
nlcontrol.translation: Manage the NETLOGON secure channel connection to a Windows Domain Controller.

nlcontrol change-password.rationale: Changes the machine authentication credential, which could temporarily disrupt domain authentication.
nlcontrol change-password.translation: Change the machine account password used for the NETLOGON secure channel.

nlcontrol reconfigure.rationale: Triggers a configuration reload; the service handles this gracefully.
nlcontrol reconfigure.translation: Force the NETLOGON service to re-read its configuration.

nlcontrol status.rationale: Read-only operation that displays the current network link control status without making changes.
nlcontrol status.translation: Display the current status of the NETLOGON secure channel.

nlcontrol verify.rationale: Tests the channel without modifying it.
nlcontrol verify.translation: Verify that the NETLOGON secure channel is working correctly.

nm.rationale: Read-only inspection of compiled file contents; does not modify any files.
nm.translation: List the named functions and variables stored inside a compiled program or library.

nmedit.rationale: Modifies the symbol table of an object file, which affects what other code can link against it.
nmedit.translation: Change global symbols to local symbols in an object file to control exported interfaces.

node.rationale: Executes arbitrary JavaScript code with full access to the filesystem and network.

nohup.rationale: Wraps another command so it ignores hangup signals; the actual risk depends on the wrapped command.
nohup.translation: Run a command that keeps running even after the terminal is closed.

nologin.rationale: A placeholder shell that prevents login; it cannot modify anything.
nologin.translation: Display a message that the account is unavailable and refuse login.

normalizer.rationale: Read-only analysis of file encoding; does not modify any files.
normalizer.translation: Detect and report the character encoding of text files.

notarytool.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
notarytool.translation: Manage submissions to the Apple notary service for macOS software distribution.

notarytool history.translation: List previous notarization submissions for your team.

notarytool info.translation: Get the status of a previous notarization submission.

notarytool log.rationale: Retrieves a log file; does not modify the submission.
notarytool log.translation: Download the notarization log for a completed submission.

notarytool store-credentials.rationale: Stores authentication credentials locally; removable from the keychain.
notarytool store-credentials.translation: Save notarization service credentials to the macOS Keychain.

notarytool submit.rationale: Sends the file to Apple for scanning; does not modify the local file but initiates an external review.
notarytool submit.translation: Upload a signed application, disk image, or installer package to Apple for notarization.

notarytool wait.rationale: Blocks until the submission completes; does not modify anything.
notarytool wait.translation: Wait for a notarization submission to finish processing.

notifyd.rationale: A system background service typically managed by launchd; does not modify user data.
notifyd.translation: Run the macOS notification server background service for inter-process event delivery.

notifyutil.rationale: Interacts with the notification system for debugging; does not modify files or services.
notifyutil.translation: Post, monitor, or inspect macOS system notifications and their state values.

npm.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

npm audit.rationale: Read-only analysis of the dependency tree against a vulnerability database.
npm audit.translation: Check installed packages for known security vulnerabilities.

npm audit fix.rationale: Modifies installed dependencies, which may introduce breaking changes or run postinstall scripts.
npm audit fix.translation: Automatically install patched versions of packages with known vulnerabilities.

npm cache clean.rationale: Removes cached package data; npm will re-download packages as needed.
npm cache clean.translation: Delete all data from the local npm cache.

npm cache verify.rationale: Checks cache contents and removes corrupt entries; safe maintenance operation.
npm cache verify.translation: Verify the integrity of the local npm cache.

npm ci.rationale: Deletes existing node_modules and reinstalls all dependencies; executes postinstall scripts.
npm ci.translation: Install project dependencies from scratch using the lockfile.

npm config get.rationale: Read-only display of a configuration value.
npm config get.translation: Display the value of a specific npm configuration setting.

npm config list.translation: Display all current npm configuration settings.

npm config set.rationale: Changes npm behavior including registry URLs, authentication tokens, and script execution settings.
npm config set.translation: Set a configuration value in the npm configuration file.

npm dedupe.rationale: Reorganizes node_modules to eliminate duplicate packages; does not add or remove dependencies.
npm dedupe.translation: Reduce duplication by restructuring the package dependency tree.

npm deprecate.rationale: Adds a public warning visible to all users of the package; reversal requires republishing.
npm deprecate.translation: Mark a package version with a deprecation warning on the registry.

npm dist-tag add.rationale: Changes which version users receive by default when installing, potentially directing them to untested code.
npm dist-tag add.translation: Assign a distribution tag to a specific published package version.

npm dist-tag rm.rationale: Removes a named tag, which may break installation workflows that reference it.
npm dist-tag rm.translation: Remove a distribution tag from a package on the registry.

npm doctor.rationale: Read-only health check of the npm installation and configuration.
npm doctor.translation: Run diagnostic checks on the npm environment.

npm exec.rationale: Downloads and executes a package, running arbitrary code even if not previously installed.
npm exec.translation: Run a command from a local or remote npm package.

npm fund.rationale: Read-only display of package funding URLs.
npm fund.translation: Display funding information for installed packages.

npm init.rationale: Generates a configuration file in the current directory; does not install or execute packages.
npm init.translation: Create a new package.json file for a project.

npm install.rationale: Downloads and executes arbitrary code via postinstall scripts from the npm registry.
npm install.translation: Install packages and their dependencies into the current project.

npm link.rationale: Modifies the global node_modules directory and can redirect package resolution to unexpected locations.
npm link.translation: Create a symbolic link to a local package for development use.

npm login.rationale: Stores registry credentials locally; does not modify packages or the registry.
npm login.translation: Authenticate to an npm registry and save the credentials locally.

npm ls.rationale: Read-only display of the installed dependency tree.
npm ls.translation: List all installed packages and their dependencies as a tree.

npm outdated.rationale: Read-only comparison of installed versions against the registry.
npm outdated.translation: Check for installed packages that have newer versions available.

npm owner.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
npm owner.translation: Manage package ownership on the npm registry.

npm owner add.rationale: Grants another user permission to publish new versions of the package.
npm owner add.translation: Add a user as a maintainer of a package on the npm registry.

npm owner rm.rationale: Revokes a user's publish access; may disrupt their workflows.
npm owner rm.translation: Remove a user as a maintainer of a package on the npm registry.

npm pack.rationale: Produces a local tarball file; does not upload anything to the registry.
npm pack.translation: Create a compressed archive of a package without publishing it.

npm prune.rationale: Removes extraneous packages from node_modules; reversible by running npm install.
npm prune.translation: Remove packages not listed as dependencies in package.json.

npm publish.rationale: Makes code publicly available on the registry; publishing incorrect or sensitive code is difficult to fully retract.
npm publish.translation: Upload a package to the npm registry.

npm rebuild.rationale: Recompiles native modules, which executes build scripts that may run arbitrary code.
npm rebuild.translation: Rebuild all installed native add-on packages.

npm run.rationale: Runs arbitrary shell commands defined in package.json scripts.
npm run.translation: Execute a script defined in the project's package.json.

npm search.translation: Search the npm registry for packages matching a query.

npm shrinkwrap.rationale: Creates a lockfile; does not install or modify packages.
npm shrinkwrap.translation: Lock down the exact versions of all dependencies into an npm-shrinkwrap.json file.

npm start.rationale: Executes arbitrary shell commands defined as the start script.
npm start.translation: Run the start script defined in the project's package.json.

npm test.rationale: Executes arbitrary shell commands defined as the test script.
npm test.translation: Run the test script defined in the project's package.json.

npm token.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
npm token.translation: Manage authentication tokens for the npm registry.

npm token create.rationale: Generates a credential that can be used to publish packages or modify account settings.
npm token create.translation: Create a new authentication token for the npm registry.

npm token list.translation: List all active authentication tokens for the npm registry.

npm token revoke.rationale: Invalidates a token; automation or CI systems using it will lose access immediately.
npm token revoke.translation: Revoke an authentication token for the npm registry.

npm uninstall.rationale: Removes files from node_modules and updates package.json; changes are local and reversible.
npm uninstall.translation: Remove a package from the current project.

npm unpublish.rationale: Removes a published version from the registry; npm enforces a 72-hour safety window and version restrictions by default.
npm unpublish.translation: Remove a package version from the npm registry.

npm update.rationale: Fetches and installs new package versions, which may introduce breaking changes or run postinstall scripts.
npm update.translation: Update installed packages to their latest allowed versions.

npm version.rationale: Modifies package.json, creates a git commit, and tags the repository.
npm version.translation: Bump the version number in package.json and create a git tag.

npm view.translation: Display information about a package from the npm registry.

npm whoami.rationale: Read-only query that prints the authenticated username.
npm whoami.translation: Display the username of the currently logged-in npm user.

npx.rationale: Downloads and executes package binaries, which may run arbitrary code from the npm registry.
npx.translation: Run a command from a local or remote npm package.

nscurl.rationale: Performs network requests; does not modify local system state beyond writing downloaded files.
nscurl.translation: Transfer data from or to a URL using the macOS NSURLSession networking API.

nslookup.rationale: Read-only network query that does not modify any system or server configuration.
nslookup.translation: Look up the address or name information for a domain using a name server.

nsupdate.rationale: Modifies live DNS records, which can redirect traffic, cause outages, or enable impersonation if used incorrectly.
nsupdate.translation: Send dynamic DNS update requests to add or remove records from a DNS zone.

numpy-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values; modifies nothing.
numpy-config.translation: Display build configuration and compiler flags for the NumPy library.

nvram.rationale: Changes to NVRAM variables affect boot configuration and hardware behavior.
nvram.translation: Read or modify firmware NVRAM variables that control boot behavior and hardware settings.

objdump.rationale: Read-only inspection of binary files; does not modify anything.
objdump.translation: Display the contents, headers, and disassembly of object files and executables.

ocspd.rationale: A system background service managed by launchd; not intended to be invoked directly.
ocspd.translation: Run the certificate revocation checking background service that caches OCSP responses and CRLs.

od.rationale: Read-only display of file contents in various numeric formats.
od.translation: Display the raw contents of a file as numbers or characters.

odutil.rationale: The bare command prints help text.
odutil.translation: Examine or change the state of the Open Directory service.

odutil reset cache.rationale: Resets authentication and directory caches, which may briefly affect directory lookups.
odutil reset cache.translation: Clear the Open Directory caches including membership and kernel caches.

odutil set log.rationale: Adjusts verbosity of log output; does not affect directory data.
odutil set log.translation: Change the logging level for the Open Directory service.

odutil show.rationale: Read-only display of cache, sessions, nodes, and statistics.
odutil show.translation: Display internal state information from the Open Directory service.

oid2name.rationale: Read-only query of PostgreSQL system catalogs; does not modify any data.
oid2name.translation: Display the relationship between PostgreSQL file nodes, table names, and OIDs.

oid2name-17.rationale: Read-only query of PostgreSQL system catalogs; does not modify any data.
oid2name-17.translation: Display the relationship between PostgreSQL 17 file nodes, table names, and OIDs.

open.rationale: Launches applications to view files; equivalent to double-clicking in Finder.
open.translation: Open a file, directory, or URL with its default application.

openai.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
openai.translation: Run the OpenAI command-line interface for API calls and client-side tools.

openai api.rationale: Sends requests to the OpenAI API, which may consume API credits and transmit data.
openai api.translation: Make direct API calls to the OpenAI service.

openclaw.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

opendiff.rationale: Launches FileMerge for visual diff; does not modify files unless the user explicitly saves a merge.
opendiff.translation: Open two files or directories in FileMerge for graphical comparison or merging.

opensnoop.rationale: Read-only tracing of file open events; requires root but does not modify anything.
opensnoop.translation: Trace file open operations across the system in real time using DTrace.

openssl.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

openssl dgst.translation: Compute a message digest or hash of a file.

openssl enc.rationale: Transforms file contents; the output replaces or creates files.
openssl enc.translation: Encrypt or decrypt data using symmetric ciphers.

openssl genrsa.rationale: Creates a private key file that grants access to encrypted data or authenticated services.
openssl genrsa.translation: Generate a new RSA private key.

openssl pkcs12.rationale: Handles certificate and key bundles; may export private keys.
openssl pkcs12.translation: Create or parse PKCS#12 certificate bundles.

openssl rand.rationale: Outputs random data; does not modify existing files.

openssl req.rationale: Generates certificate requests or self-signed certificates; local file operation.
openssl req.translation: Create or process certificate signing requests.

openssl rsa.rationale: Reads and writes key files, which may expose private key material if misused.
openssl rsa.translation: Process and convert RSA key files.

openssl s_client.rationale: Diagnostic tool for inspecting TLS connections; primarily read-only.
openssl s_client.translation: Connect to a remote server and display its TLS certificate details.

openssl verify.rationale: Read-only validation of certificate trust chains.
openssl verify.translation: Verify a certificate against a certificate authority chain.

openssl x509.rationale: Reads, converts, or signs certificates; primarily informational.

osacompile.rationale: Produces a compiled script file; does not execute the script.
osacompile.translation: Compile AppleScript or other Open Scripting Architecture language source files into a compiled script or application.

osadecompile.rationale: Read-only decompilation that writes source text to the terminal.
osadecompile.translation: Display the source text of a compiled AppleScript file.

osalang.rationale: Read-only display of installed language components.
osalang.translation: List the installed Open Scripting Architecture scripting languages available on the system.

osascript.rationale: Executes arbitrary scripts that can control applications, modify files, and interact with system services.
osascript.translation: Execute an AppleScript, JavaScript for Automation, or other Open Scripting Architecture language script.

otctl.rationale: Read-only diagnostic output for sysdiagnose; does not modify keychain data.
otctl.translation: Display diagnostic information about iCloud Keychain syncing and trust state.

otool.rationale: Read-only inspection of binary file metadata and code; does not modify anything.
otool.translation: Display the contents and structure of Apple platform object files and libraries.

package-stash-conflicts.rationale: Read-only diagnostic that checks module version compatibility.
package-stash-conflicts.translation: Check for conflicts between the pure-Perl and native-extension versions of the Package::Stash module.

package-stash-conflicts5.34.rationale: Read-only diagnostic that checks module version compatibility.
package-stash-conflicts5.34.translation: Check for conflicts between the pure-Perl and native-extension versions of the Package::Stash module for Perl 5.34.

pagesize.rationale: Read-only display of a system constant.
pagesize.translation: Print the system memory page size in bytes.

pagestuff.rationale: Read-only analysis of binary file layout; does not modify anything.
pagestuff.translation: Display how the structure of an Apple platform binary file maps to memory pages.

pal2rgb.rationale: Reads an input file and writes a new output file; the original is not modified.
pal2rgb.translation: Convert a palette-color TIFF image to a full-color RGB TIFF image.

pango-list.translation: List all fonts available to the Pango text rendering library.

pango-segmentation.rationale: Read-only text analysis; produces only diagnostic output.
pango-segmentation.translation: Analyze and display text segmentation boundaries using the Pango library.

pango-view.rationale: Produces rendered text output; does not modify system state.
pango-view.translation: Render text to an image or display using the Pango text layout library.

par.pl.rationale: Executes arbitrary Perl code from an archive, which could modify files or system state.
par.pl.translation: Run a Perl application packaged in a PAR archive.

par5.34.pl.rationale: Executes arbitrary Perl code from an archive, which could modify files or system state.
par5.34.pl.translation: Run a Perl application packaged in a PAR archive using Perl 5.34.

parl.rationale: Executes arbitrary Perl code from an archive.
parl.translation: Run the PAR Perl archive loader to execute packaged Perl applications.

parl5.34.rationale: Executes arbitrary Perl code from an archive.
parl5.34.translation: Run the PAR Perl archive loader using Perl 5.34.

passwd.rationale: Modifies authentication credentials; an incorrect password change can lock out the user.

paste.rationale: Read-only operation that combines lines and prints to the terminal; input files are not modified.
paste.translation: Merge corresponding lines from multiple files side by side.

patch.rationale: Modifies files on disk according to a patch file; changes can be reversed.
patch.translation: Apply a diff file to modify source files.

pathchk.rationale: Read-only validation of pathname strings; does not create or modify files.
pathchk.translation: Check whether pathnames are valid and portable.

pathopens.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of file open events; requires root but does not modify anything.
pathopens.d.translation: Count how many times each file path has been successfully opened, using DTrace.

pax.rationale: Can extract files that overwrite existing data, or create archives from the filesystem.
pax.translation: Read, write, and list file archives, or copy directory hierarchies.

pbcopy.rationale: Places text on the pasteboard; overwrites only clipboard contents, which is trivially reversible.
pbcopy.translation: Copy standard input to the macOS clipboard.

pbpaste.translation: Output the current contents of the macOS clipboard to standard output.

pcap-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.
pcap-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags needed to build applications against libpcap.

pcre2-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.
pcre2-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags needed to build applications against the PCRE2 library.

pcre2grep.rationale: Read-only search that displays matching lines; does not modify files.
pcre2grep.translation: Search files for lines matching a Perl-compatible regular expression.

pcre2test.rationale: Read-only regex testing tool; does not modify any files.
pcre2test.translation: Test regular expression patterns against input strings using the PCRE2 library.

pdb2mdb.rationale: Creates a new debug file alongside the assembly; does not modify the original files.
pdb2mdb.translation: Convert Windows program database debug symbol files to Mono debug format.

pdisk.rationale: Modifying partition tables can destroy all data on the disk if done incorrectly.
pdisk.translation: View or edit Apple partition tables on disk devices.

perl.rationale: Executes arbitrary Perl code, which can modify files, make network requests, or run system commands.

perl5.34.rationale: Executes arbitrary Perl code, which could modify files or system state.
perl5.34.translation: Run the Perl 5.34 programming language interpreter.

perlbug.rationale: Collects system information and creates a report template; sends email only with user confirmation.
perlbug.translation: Generate and send a bug report for the Perl programming language.

perlbug5.34.rationale: Collects system information and creates a report template.
perlbug5.34.translation: Generate and send a bug report for Perl 5.34.

perldoc.rationale: Read-only display of Perl documentation; does not modify anything.
perldoc.translation: Look up and display Perl documentation in Pod format.

perlivp.rationale: Read-only diagnostic that tests the Perl installation.
perlivp.translation: Verify that the Perl installation is complete and functional.

perlivp5.34.rationale: Read-only diagnostic that tests the Perl installation.
perlivp5.34.translation: Verify that the Perl 5.34 installation is complete and functional.

perlthanks.rationale: Composes an email; sends only with user confirmation.
perlthanks.translation: Send a thank-you message to the Perl developers.

perlthanks5.34.rationale: Composes an email; sends only with user confirmation.
perlthanks5.34.translation: Send a thank-you message to the Perl 5.34 developers.

permview.rationale: Read-only inspection of assembly security metadata.
permview.translation: Display the security permissions declared in a .NET assembly.

pfctl.rationale: Manages firewall rules that control network traffic; incorrect changes can block connectivity.
pfctl.translation: Control the macOS packet filter firewall and network address translation rules.

pg_amcheck.rationale: Read-only integrity verification that does not modify any data.
pg_amcheck.translation: Check PostgreSQL database objects for corruption.

pg_amcheck-17.rationale: Read-only integrity verification that does not modify any data.
pg_amcheck-17.translation: Check PostgreSQL database objects for corruption.

pg_archivecleanup.rationale: Permanently deletes WAL archive files, which may be needed for point-in-time recovery.
pg_archivecleanup.translation: Remove old WAL files from a PostgreSQL archive directory.

pg_archivecleanup-17.rationale: Permanently deletes WAL archive files, which may be needed for point-in-time recovery.
pg_archivecleanup-17.translation: Remove old WAL files from a PostgreSQL archive directory.

pg_basebackup.rationale: Creates a backup copy of the database; does not modify the running server.
pg_basebackup.translation: Take a base backup of a running PostgreSQL server.

pg_basebackup-17.rationale: Creates a backup copy of the database; does not modify the running server.
pg_basebackup-17.translation: Take a base backup of a running PostgreSQL server.

pg_checksums.rationale: By default performs a read-only check; enabling or disabling checksums modifies data files.
pg_checksums.translation: Enable, disable, or verify data checksums in a PostgreSQL database cluster.

pg_checksums-17.rationale: By default performs a read-only check; enabling or disabling checksums modifies data files.
pg_checksums-17.translation: Enable, disable, or verify data checksums in a PostgreSQL database cluster.

pg_combinebackup.rationale: Creates a new full backup from incremental pieces; does not modify the source backups.
pg_combinebackup.translation: Combine an incremental PostgreSQL backup with its base to produce a full backup.

pg_combinebackup-17.rationale: Creates a new full backup from incremental pieces; does not modify the source backups.
pg_combinebackup-17.translation: Combine an incremental PostgreSQL backup with its base to produce a full backup.

pg_config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.
pg_config.translation: Display information about the installed version of PostgreSQL.

pg_config-17.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.
pg_config-17.translation: Display information about the installed version of PostgreSQL.

pg_controldata.translation: Display control information of a PostgreSQL database cluster.

pg_controldata-17.translation: Display control information of a PostgreSQL database cluster.

pg_createsubscriber.rationale: Permanently changes the replication mode of a standby, which cannot be easily reversed.
pg_createsubscriber.translation: Convert a PostgreSQL physical standby server into a logical replication subscriber.

pg_createsubscriber-17.rationale: Permanently changes the replication mode of a standby, which cannot be easily reversed.
pg_createsubscriber-17.translation: Convert a PostgreSQL physical standby server into a logical replication subscriber.

pg_ctl.rationale: Controls the lifecycle of a database server; stopping it interrupts all connections.
pg_ctl.translation: Initialize, start, stop, or control a PostgreSQL database server.

pg_ctl-17.rationale: Controls the lifecycle of a database server; stopping it interrupts all connections.
pg_ctl-17.translation: Initialize, start, stop, or control a PostgreSQL database server.

pg_dump.rationale: Read-only operation that exports data without modifying the database.
pg_dump.translation: Export a PostgreSQL database to a file or standard output.

pg_dump-17.rationale: Read-only export that does not modify the source database.
pg_dump-17.translation: Export a PostgreSQL 17 database into a script file or archive format.

pg_dumpall.rationale: Read-only export that does not modify any databases.
pg_dumpall.translation: Export all PostgreSQL databases and global objects into an SQL script.

pg_dumpall-17.rationale: Read-only export that does not modify any databases.
pg_dumpall-17.translation: Export all PostgreSQL databases and global objects into an SQL script.

pg_isready.rationale: Read-only connection check that does not modify anything.
pg_isready.translation: Check whether a PostgreSQL server is ready to accept connections.

pg_isready-17.rationale: Read-only connection check that does not modify anything.
pg_isready-17.translation: Check whether a PostgreSQL server is ready to accept connections.

pg_receivewal.rationale: Receives and stores WAL files locally for backup purposes; does not modify the server.
pg_receivewal.translation: Stream write-ahead log records from a PostgreSQL server to a local directory.

pg_receivewal-17.rationale: Receives and stores WAL files locally for backup purposes; does not modify the server.
pg_receivewal-17.translation: Stream write-ahead log records from a PostgreSQL server to a local directory.

pg_recvlogical.rationale: Receives logical decoding output; does not modify the source database.
pg_recvlogical.translation: Stream logical replication changes from a PostgreSQL server.

pg_recvlogical-17.rationale: Receives logical decoding output; does not modify the source database.
pg_recvlogical-17.translation: Stream logical replication changes from a PostgreSQL server.

pg_resetwal.rationale: Forcibly resets WAL state, which can cause data loss and corruption if used on a functioning cluster.
pg_resetwal.translation: Reset the write-ahead log and other control information of a PostgreSQL database cluster.

pg_resetwal-17.rationale: Forcibly resets WAL state, which can cause data loss and corruption if used on a functioning cluster.
pg_resetwal-17.translation: Reset the write-ahead log and other control information of a PostgreSQL database cluster.

pg_restore.rationale: Modifies a database by creating objects and loading data, potentially overwriting existing data.
pg_restore.translation: Restore a PostgreSQL database from an archive created by pg_dump.

pg_restore-17.rationale: Modifies a database by creating objects and loading data, potentially overwriting existing data.
pg_restore-17.translation: Restore a PostgreSQL 17 database from an archive created by pg_dump.

pg_rewind.rationale: Overwrites data files in the target cluster to match the source, discarding divergent changes.
pg_rewind.translation: Synchronize a PostgreSQL data directory with another copy that has diverged.

pg_rewind-17.rationale: Overwrites data files in the target cluster to match the source, discarding divergent changes.
pg_rewind-17.translation: Synchronize a PostgreSQL data directory with another copy that has diverged.

pg_test_fsync.rationale: Read-only benchmark that tests disk sync performance.
pg_test_fsync.translation: Test the speed of various fsync methods available to PostgreSQL.

pg_test_fsync-17.rationale: Read-only benchmark that tests disk sync performance.
pg_test_fsync-17.translation: Test the speed of various fsync methods available to PostgreSQL.

pg_test_timing.rationale: Read-only benchmark that measures timer overhead.
pg_test_timing.translation: Test the accuracy of the system timer used by PostgreSQL.

pg_test_timing-17.rationale: Read-only benchmark that measures timer overhead.
pg_test_timing-17.translation: Test the accuracy of the system timer used by PostgreSQL.

pg_upgrade.rationale: Modifies the database cluster in place; a failed upgrade can leave the cluster in an unusable state.
pg_upgrade.translation: Upgrade a PostgreSQL database cluster to a new major version.

pg_upgrade-17.rationale: Modifies the database cluster in place; a failed upgrade can leave the cluster in an unusable state.
pg_upgrade-17.translation: Upgrade a PostgreSQL database cluster to a new major version.

pg_verifybackup.rationale: Read-only verification that checks backup files against their manifest.
pg_verifybackup.translation: Verify the integrity of a PostgreSQL base backup.

pg_verifybackup-17.rationale: Read-only verification that checks backup files against their manifest.
pg_verifybackup-17.translation: Verify the integrity of a PostgreSQL base backup.

pg_waldump.translation: Display the contents of PostgreSQL write-ahead log files in human-readable format.

pg_waldump-17.translation: Display the contents of PostgreSQL write-ahead log files in human-readable format.

pg_walsummary.translation: Display a summary of PostgreSQL write-ahead log records.

pg_walsummary-17.translation: Display a summary of PostgreSQL write-ahead log records.

pgbench.rationale: Creates test tables and generates load on the database, which can affect performance of other queries.
pgbench.translation: Run a benchmark test against a PostgreSQL database.

pgbench-17.rationale: Creates test tables and generates load on the database, which can affect performance of other queries.
pgbench-17.translation: Run a benchmark test against a PostgreSQL database.

pgrep.rationale: Read-only process table search; does not modify or signal any processes.
pgrep.translation: Search for processes by name or other attributes and print their process IDs.

php.rationale: Executes arbitrary scripting code, which can modify files, make network requests, or run system commands.
php.translation: Run the php scripting language interpreter.

pico.rationale: Opens files for editing; changes are written to disk on save.
pico.translation: Edit text files using a simple terminal-based text editor.

piconv.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes output to the terminal.
piconv.translation: Convert text between character encodings using Perl.

piconv5.34.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes output to the terminal.
piconv5.34.translation: Convert text between character encodings using Perl 5.34.

pidpersec.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of process creation rates.
pidpersec.d.translation: Trace the rate of new process creation using DTrace.

ping.rationale: Read-only network diagnostic that does not modify any system or remote state.
ping.translation: Send test packets to a network host to check if it is reachable.

ping6.rationale: Read-only network diagnostic that sends and receives ping packets.
ping6.translation: Send ICMPv6 echo requests to test IPv6 network connectivity.

pip uninstall.rationale: Deletes installed packages, which may break dependent applications.

pip3 cache list.rationale: Read-only listing of cached package files.

pip3 config unset.rationale: Restores a single configuration key to its default; easily re-set.

pip3 freeze.rationale: Read-only output of package versions suitable for piping to a file.

pip3.14 uninstall.rationale: Removes packages that other packages or scripts may depend on.

pkgbuild.rationale: Creates a package file; does not install anything.
pkgbuild.translation: Build a macOS Installer component package from files on disk.

pkgutil.rationale: Primarily reads package metadata and receipt information.
pkgutil.translation: Query and manipulate macOS installer packages and installation receipts.

pkill.rationale: Signals processes by pattern match, which can terminate critical services if the pattern is too broad.
pkill.translation: Send a signal to all processes whose names match a pattern.

pl.rationale: Interactive exploration tool; does not modify files.
pl.translation: Run the PropertyList programming environment for exploring Objective-C objects interactively.

pl2pm.rationale: Generates a new module file; does not modify the original.
pl2pm.translation: Convert Perl 4 library files to Perl 5 module format.

pl2pm5.34.rationale: Generates a new module file; does not modify the original.
pl2pm5.34.translation: Convert Perl 4 library files to Perl 5.34 module format.

playwright.rationale: Controls web browsers programmatically, which can navigate to URLs and interact with web pages.
playwright.translation: Run the Playwright browser automation and testing framework.

plockstat.rationale: Read-only tracing of lock contention; requires root but does not modify anything.
plockstat.translation: Trace lock statistics for user-level lock primitives using DTrace.

pluginkit.rationale: Primarily queries plugin metadata; modifications require explicit flags.
pluginkit.translation: Manage macOS app extensions and plugins.

plutil.rationale: By default performs a read-only lint check; conversion and modification require explicit command options.
plutil.translation: Check syntax, convert formats, and modify property list files.

pmset.rationale: Modifies system power settings that affect sleep, wake, and energy behavior.
pmset.translation: View or change macOS power management settings such as sleep timers and wake behavior.

png-fix-itxt.rationale: Repairs metadata in PNG files; the image data itself is not affected.
png-fix-itxt.translation: Fix invalid iTXt chunks in PNG image files.

pnpm.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.
pnpm.translation: Run the pnpm package manager for JavaScript projects.

pnpm add.rationale: Downloads and installs a package, modifying package.json and the lockfile.
pnpm add.translation: Add a dependency to the project.

pnpm audit.translation: Check installed packages for known security vulnerabilities.

pnpm config.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

pnpm create.rationale: Downloads and runs a project scaffolding tool from the registry.
pnpm create.translation: Create a new project from a starter kit package.

pnpm dlx.rationale: Downloads and executes remote code from the registry.
pnpm dlx.translation: Run a package in a temporary environment without installing it permanently.

pnpm exec.rationale: Runs an arbitrary command with access to project binaries.
pnpm exec.translation: Execute a command in the project's package environment.

pnpm init.rationale: Creates a configuration file; does not install anything.
pnpm init.translation: Create a new package.json file in the current directory.

pnpm install.rationale: Downloads and installs packages from the registry, which execute install scripts.
pnpm install.translation: Install all dependencies listed in the project's package.json.

pnpm list.translation: List all installed packages and their dependency trees.

pnpm outdated.rationale: Read-only comparison of installed versus latest versions.
pnpm outdated.translation: Check for outdated packages in the project.

pnpm publish.rationale: Makes the package publicly available on the registry, which is difficult to fully undo.
pnpm publish.translation: Publish a package to the npm registry.

pnpm remove.rationale: Uninstalls a package and modifies package.json and the lockfile.
pnpm remove.translation: Remove a dependency from the project.

pnpm run.rationale: Executes an arbitrary script, which may perform any action.
pnpm run.translation: Run a script defined in the project's package.json.

pnpm self-update.rationale: Updates the pnpm binary itself; does not affect project dependencies.
pnpm self-update.translation: Update pnpm to the latest version.

pnpm store.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
pnpm store.translation: Manage the pnpm content-addressable package store.

pnpm store prune.rationale: Deletes cached packages no longer referenced by any project; they will be re-downloaded if needed.
pnpm store prune.translation: Remove unreferenced packages from the pnpm content-addressable store.

pnpm update.rationale: Modifies the lockfile and installs new versions that may introduce breaking changes.
pnpm update.translation: Update project dependencies to newer versions.

pnpm why.rationale: Read-only display of the dependency chain.
pnpm why.translation: Show all packages that depend on a specified package.

pnpx.rationale: Downloads and executes code from the npm registry.
pnpx.translation: Execute a package binary using the pnpm package manager without installing it globally.

po-fetch.rationale: Downloads translation files; does not modify existing project files.
po-fetch.translation: Fetch translation files from a translation service.

pod2html.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes HTML to the terminal or a specified file.
pod2html.translation: Convert Perl Pod documentation to HTML format.

pod2man.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes to the terminal.
pod2man.translation: Convert Perl Pod documentation to Unix manual page format.

pod2man5.34.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes to the terminal.
pod2man5.34.translation: Convert Perl Pod documentation to Unix manual page format using Perl 5.34.

pod2readme.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes to the terminal.
pod2readme.translation: Convert Perl Pod documentation to a plain text readme file.

pod2readme5.34.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes to the terminal.
pod2readme5.34.translation: Convert Perl Pod documentation to a plain text readme file using Perl 5.34.

pod2text.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes to the terminal.
pod2text.translation: Convert Perl Pod documentation to plain text.

pod2usage.rationale: Read-only extraction that writes to the terminal.
pod2usage.translation: Extract and display usage information from Perl Pod documentation.

podchecker.rationale: Read-only validation; does not modify files.
podchecker.translation: Check Perl Pod documentation files for syntax errors.

postalias.rationale: Modifies the alias database, which affects how email is routed.
postalias.translation: Create or query a Postfix alias database.

postcat.rationale: Read-only display of mail queue file contents.
postcat.translation: Display the contents of a Postfix queue file.

postconf.rationale: Can change mail server configuration that affects mail delivery behavior.
postconf.translation: Display or modify Postfix mail server configuration parameters.

postdrop.rationale: Adds a message to the queue; typically invoked by sendmail.
postdrop.translation: Submit a mail message from the command line into the Postfix mail queue.

postfix.rationale: Starts, stops, and manages the mail server, which affects email delivery for the system.
postfix.translation: Control the Postfix mail server system.

postgres.rationale: Starts the database server process; typically managed by pg_ctl rather than invoked directly.

postgres-17.rationale: Starts the database server process; typically managed by pg_ctl rather than invoked directly.

postkick.rationale: Internal Postfix utility for inter-process communication.
postkick.translation: Send a command to a Postfix service over a local transport channel.

postlock.rationale: Creates a lock file; the lock is released when the command completes.
postlock.translation: Acquire a Postfix-compatible lock on a file and execute a command.

postlog.rationale: Appends a log entry; does not modify mail or configuration.
postlog.translation: Write a message to the Postfix logging system.

postmap.rationale: Rebuilds lookup tables that affect mail routing and delivery.
postmap.translation: Create or query a Postfix lookup table from a text file.

postmulti.rationale: Creates, enables, disables, or destroys Postfix instances.
postmulti.translation: Manage multiple Postfix instances on the same machine.

postqueue.rationale: Lists queued mail or triggers delivery; does not delete messages.
postqueue.translation: View or flush the Postfix mail queue.

postsuper.rationale: Can delete, hold, or requeue messages in the mail queue.
postsuper.translation: Perform maintenance on the Postfix mail queue.

powermetrics.rationale: Read-only monitoring of system power and performance metrics.
powermetrics.translation: Display detailed CPU, GPU, and power usage statistics for the system.

pp.rationale: Creates a packaged executable file; does not modify the source script.
