terraform.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

terraform apply.rationale: Modifies live cloud infrastructure, which may cause service disruption and incur costs.
terraform apply.translation: Create or update infrastructure to match the Terraform configuration.

terraform console.rationale: Interactive evaluation environment; does not modify state or infrastructure.
terraform console.translation: Open an interactive console for evaluating Terraform expressions.

terraform destroy.rationale: Permanently deletes all managed resources including compute, databases, and networking.
terraform destroy.translation: Destroy all infrastructure managed by the current Terraform configuration.

terraform fmt.rationale: Modifies only whitespace and formatting in local files; semantics are unchanged.
terraform fmt.translation: Reformat Terraform configuration files to the standard style.

terraform force-unlock.rationale: Forcibly removes the lock, which may allow conflicting operations to corrupt the state.
terraform force-unlock.translation: Manually release a stuck state lock.

terraform get.rationale: Downloads module source code; does not modify state or infrastructure.
terraform get.translation: Download and update the modules referenced in the configuration.

terraform graph.rationale: Read-only graph generation that does not modify state or infrastructure.
terraform graph.translation: Generate a visual dependency graph of Terraform resources.

terraform import.rationale: Modifies the state file to track an existing resource; does not change infrastructure.
terraform import.translation: Bring an existing infrastructure resource under Terraform management.

terraform init.rationale: Sets up local state and downloads dependencies; safe to run repeatedly.
terraform init.translation: Initialize a Terraform working directory by downloading providers and modules.

terraform login.rationale: Stores authentication credentials on disk, which could be exposed if the machine is compromised.
terraform login.translation: Authenticate with a remote Terraform service and save the credentials locally.

terraform logout.rationale: Deletes local authentication tokens; does not affect remote infrastructure.
terraform logout.translation: Remove locally stored credentials for a remote Terraform service.

terraform output.rationale: Read-only display of output values from the state.
terraform output.translation: Display the output values defined in the Terraform configuration.

terraform plan.rationale: Read-only operation that queries providers but does not modify any infrastructure.
terraform plan.translation: Generate an execution plan showing what changes Terraform would make to infrastructure.

terraform providers.translation: Show the providers required by the current configuration.

terraform refresh.rationale: Modifies the state file, which may cause future plans to show unexpected changes.
terraform refresh.translation: Update the Terraform state to match the current real-world infrastructure.

terraform show.rationale: Read-only display of state or plan data.
terraform show.translation: Display the current state or a saved plan in human-readable form.

terraform state.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
terraform state.translation: Perform advanced operations on the Terraform state file.

terraform state list.translation: List all resources tracked in the Terraform state.

terraform state mv.rationale: Renames or restructures resources in state; incorrect moves can cause resources to be recreated.
terraform state mv.translation: Move a resource to a different address in the Terraform state.

terraform state pull.rationale: Read-only retrieval of the state file.
terraform state pull.translation: Download the current remote state and print it to standard output.

terraform state push.rationale: Overwrites the remote state, which can cause other users to lose track of managed resources.
terraform state push.translation: Upload a local state file to the configured remote backend.

terraform state replace-provider.rationale: Changes which provider manages resources in state; incorrect replacement may cause resources to be recreated.
terraform state replace-provider.translation: Replace the provider recorded in the state for existing resources.

terraform state rm.rationale: Terraform forgets the resource, which means it will no longer be managed or protected from drift.
terraform state rm.translation: Remove a resource from Terraform state without destroying the real infrastructure.

terraform state show.translation: Display the attributes of a single resource in the Terraform state.

terraform taint.rationale: Does not destroy the resource immediately, but the next apply will replace it.
terraform taint.translation: Mark a resource instance as degraded so it will be recreated on the next apply.

terraform test.rationale: Executes test assertions against the configuration; may create temporary infrastructure in test mode.
terraform test.translation: Run integration tests defined for Terraform modules.

terraform untaint.rationale: Removes the taint mark; prevents unnecessary destruction on the next apply.
terraform untaint.translation: Remove the tainted status from a resource instance so it will not be recreated.

terraform validate.rationale: Read-only validation that does not contact remote services or modify state.
terraform validate.translation: Check whether the Terraform configuration files are syntactically valid.

terraform workspace.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.
terraform workspace.translation: Manage Terraform workspaces for isolating state environments.

terraform workspace delete.rationale: Permanently removes the workspace state; resources tracked in it become unmanaged.
terraform workspace delete.translation: Delete a Terraform workspace and its state.

terraform workspace new.rationale: Creates a new isolated state environment; does not affect existing workspaces.

terraform workspace select.rationale: Changes which state file subsequent commands operate on; the wrong workspace may target production.
terraform workspace select.translation: Switch to a different Terraform workspace.

terraform workspace show.rationale: Read-only display of the current workspace.
terraform workspace show.translation: Display the name of the currently selected workspace.

test.rationale: Read-only evaluation that only sets an exit code; modifies nothing.
test.translation: Evaluate a condition and return success or failure.

textutil.rationale: Can modify files in place when converting formats; the original format is lost without a backup.
textutil.translation: Convert and manipulate text documents between various formats.

tftp.rationale: Sends and receives files over the network without authentication; files can be overwritten on the remote or local side.
tftp.translation: Transfer files using the Trivial File Transfer Protocol.

tic.rationale: Compiles terminal descriptions; writes to the terminfo database but does not affect running terminals.
tic.translation: Compile terminfo source files into the terminal capability database.

tidy.rationale: Writes reformatted output to the terminal by default; original files are unchanged unless -m is used.
tidy.translation: Clean up and reformat HTML and XML files.

tiff2bw.rationale: Creates a new output file; the original image is unchanged.
tiff2bw.translation: Convert a color TIFF image to black and white.

tiff2icns.rationale: Creates a new icns file; the original TIFF is unchanged.
tiff2icns.translation: Convert a TIFF image to a macOS icon file.

tiff2pdf.rationale: Creates a new PDF file; the original TIFF is unchanged.
tiff2pdf.translation: Convert a TIFF image to a PDF document.

tiff2ps.rationale: Writes PostScript to the terminal; the original TIFF is unchanged.
tiff2ps.translation: Convert a TIFF image to PostScript format.

tiff2rgba.rationale: Creates a new output file; the original image is unchanged.
tiff2rgba.translation: Convert a TIFF image to red-green-blue-alpha color format.

tiffcmp.translation: Compare two TIFF images and report differences.

tiffcp.rationale: Creates a new output file; original files are unchanged.
tiffcp.translation: Copy and optionally recompress TIFF images.

tiffcrop.rationale: Creates a new output file with cropped content; original is unchanged.
tiffcrop.translation: Crop and extract regions from TIFF images.

tiffdither.rationale: Creates a new output file; the original image is unchanged.
tiffdither.translation: Convert a greyscale TIFF image to bilevel using dithering.

tiffdump.rationale: Read-only display of internal TIFF structure; modifies nothing.
tiffdump.translation: Display the raw structure and tags of a TIFF file.

tiffinfo.rationale: Read-only display of TIFF file information; modifies nothing.
tiffinfo.translation: Display metadata and properties of a TIFF image.

tiffmedian.rationale: Creates a new output file; the original image is unchanged.
tiffmedian.translation: Reduce the color palette of a TIFF image using median cut.

tiffset.rationale: Modifies metadata in the TIFF file in place; original tag values are overwritten.
tiffset.translation: Set or modify TIFF image metadata tags.

tiffsplit.rationale: Creates new files for each page; the original multi-page TIFF is unchanged.
tiffsplit.translation: Split a multi-page TIFF into individual single-page TIFF files.

tiffutil.rationale: Creates new output files; does not modify originals by default.
tiffutil.translation: Manipulate TIFF files including concatenation, extraction, and information display.

time.rationale: Runs a command and reports timing statistics; the timing itself adds no risk.
time.translation: Measure the execution time of a command.

timeout.rationale: Executes a command and stops it if it exceeds the specified duration; the bare command only adds a time constraint.
timeout.translation: Run a command with a time limit.

timerfires.rationale: Read-only monitoring of system timer events; modifies nothing.
timerfires.translation: Report timer firings and their associated processes.

tiny-agents.rationale: Executes AI agent code that may perform actions based on model output; behavior depends on agent configuration.
tiny-agents.translation: Run lightweight AI agents from the Hugging Face ecosystem.

tkcon.rationale: Launches a Tcl interpreter console; risk depends on commands executed within it.
tkcon.translation: Run an enhanced interactive Tcl/Tk console.

tkmib.rationale: Read-only MIB browser; does not modify SNMP devices.
tkmib.translation: Browse and query SNMP MIB trees using a graphical Tk interface.

tldextract.translation: Extract the top-level domain, domain, and subdomain from a URL.

tmdiagnose.rationale: Gathers logs and state into a diagnostic archive; does not modify backup configuration.
tmdiagnose.translation: Collect diagnostic information about Time Machine for troubleshooting.

tmutil.rationale: The bare command prints help; specific verbs have varying risk levels.
tmutil.translation: Control and interact with Time Machine backups.

tmutil addexclusion.rationale: Items excluded will not be backed up; data loss is possible if the item is later damaged.
tmutil addexclusion.translation: Exclude a file, directory, or volume from future Time Machine backups.

tmutil associatedisk.rationale: Reconfigures the backup history association; incorrect use may cause unnecessary full re-backups.
tmutil associatedisk.translation: Associate a volume store in a backup with a different local disk.

tmutil calculatedrift.rationale: Read-only analysis that computes differences without modifying anything.
tmutil calculatedrift.translation: Analyze the amount of change between successive backups in a machine directory.

tmutil compare.rationale: Read-only comparison that displays differences without modifying anything.
tmutil compare.translation: Compare the current system to a backup, or compare two backups.

tmutil delete.rationale: Permanently removes backup snapshots; the deleted backup data cannot be recovered.
tmutil delete.translation: Delete one or more Time Machine backups.

tmutil deletelocalsnapshots.rationale: Permanently removes local backup snapshots; recovery of deleted snapshot data is not possible.
tmutil deletelocalsnapshots.translation: Delete local Time Machine snapshots for a specified date or volume.

tmutil destinationinfo.rationale: Read-only display of backup destination settings.
tmutil destinationinfo.translation: Display information about configured backup destinations.

tmutil disable.rationale: Stops automatic backups, which may leave data unprotected.
tmutil disable.translation: Turn off automatic Time Machine backups.

tmutil enable.rationale: Enables backup scheduling; only adds data to the backup destination.
tmutil enable.translation: Turn on automatic Time Machine backups.

tmutil inheritbackup.rationale: Reassigns backup identity; the previous computer will no longer recognize the backup as its own.
tmutil inheritbackup.translation: Claim ownership of a backup created by another computer.

tmutil isexcluded.rationale: Read-only query that checks exclusion status.
tmutil isexcluded.translation: Check whether a file, directory, or volume is excluded from backups.

tmutil latestbackup.rationale: Read-only query that prints backup information.
tmutil latestbackup.translation: Display the path to the most recent completed backup.

tmutil listbackups.rationale: Read-only operation that lists Time Machine backup snapshots without modifying or deleting any.
tmutil listbackups.translation: List all available Time Machine backups.

tmutil listlocalsnapshotdates.translation: List the creation dates of all local Time Machine snapshots.

tmutil listlocalsnapshots.translation: List local APFS snapshots created by Time Machine.

tmutil localsnapshot.rationale: Creates a read-only snapshot; does not modify or delete any data.
tmutil localsnapshot.translation: Create a new local Time Machine snapshot of all APFS backup volumes.

tmutil removedestination.rationale: Disconnects a backup destination; existing backups remain on the disk but are no longer managed.
tmutil removedestination.translation: Remove a backup destination from the Time Machine configuration.

tmutil removeexclusion.rationale: Re-enables backup for an item; no data loss.
tmutil removeexclusion.translation: Remove a previously configured Time Machine exclusion.

tmutil restore.rationale: Writes backup data to the filesystem; may overwrite existing files at the destination.
tmutil restore.translation: Restore files from a Time Machine backup to a specified location.

tmutil setdestination.rationale: Changes where backups are stored; replacing destinations may make old backups inaccessible.
tmutil setdestination.translation: Configure a volume or network share as a Time Machine backup destination.

tmutil startbackup.rationale: Initiates a backup which only adds data; does not modify or delete source files.
tmutil startbackup.translation: Start a Time Machine backup immediately.

tmutil stopbackup.rationale: Interrupts the backup process; the partial backup remains valid.
tmutil stopbackup.translation: Stop a currently running Time Machine backup.

tmutil thinlocalsnapshots.rationale: Deletes snapshots to free space; removed backup points cannot be recovered.
tmutil thinlocalsnapshots.translation: Reclaim disk space by removing local snapshots until a target free space is reached.

tmutil uniquesize.rationale: Read-only analysis that does not modify backup data.
tmutil uniquesize.translation: Calculate the unique size of a backup that is not shared with other backups.

tmutil verifychecksums.rationale: Read-only integrity check that does not modify backup data.
tmutil verifychecksums.translation: Verify the integrity of files in a Time Machine backup by checking stored checksums.

tmux.rationale: The bare command starts a new session; no data is modified or destroyed.

tmux attach-session.rationale: Read-write access to an existing session, but no data is destroyed.
tmux attach-session.translation: Reconnect to an existing terminal session.

tmux detach-client.rationale: The session continues running in the background; no data is lost.
tmux detach-client.translation: Disconnect a client from its terminal session without stopping it.

tmux kill-session.rationale: Ends a session and stops all programs running inside it; unsaved work in those programs may be lost.
tmux kill-session.translation: Terminate a terminal session and all its programs.

tmux kill-window.rationale: Terminates all panes and programs in the window; unsaved work may be lost.
tmux kill-window.translation: Close a window and stop all programs running in it.

tmux new-session.rationale: Starts a new session without affecting existing sessions or data.

tmux new-window.rationale: Adds a window without affecting existing windows or data.
tmux new-window.translation: Create a new window in the current session.

tmux send-keys.rationale: Injects keystrokes into a running program, which could trigger any action that program supports.
tmux send-keys.translation: Send keyboard input to a terminal pane.

tmux split-window.rationale: Creates an additional pane in the current window; no data is modified.
tmux split-window.translation: Split the current window into two panes.

toe.rationale: Read-only listing of terminal types; modifies nothing.
toe.translation: List all available terminal type entries in the terminfo database.

tofu.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

tofu apply.rationale: Modifies live cloud infrastructure; prompts for confirmation by default.
tofu apply.translation: Create or update infrastructure to match the OpenTofu configuration.

tofu console.rationale: Read-only evaluation of expressions against the current state.
tofu console.translation: Open an interactive console for evaluating OpenTofu expressions.

tofu destroy.rationale: Tears down all managed resources; data loss is likely without external backups.
tofu destroy.translation: Destroy all infrastructure managed by OpenTofu.

tofu fmt.rationale: Modifies local files cosmetically; does not affect infrastructure.
tofu fmt.translation: Reformat OpenTofu configuration files to the standard style.

tofu force-unlock.rationale: Forcibly removes a lock that may be held by another running operation, risking state corruption.

tofu get.rationale: Downloads module source code; does not modify infrastructure.
tofu get.translation: Download and install modules referenced in the configuration.

tofu graph.rationale: Read-only output of the resource dependency structure.
tofu graph.translation: Generate a dependency graph of the OpenTofu configuration.

tofu import.rationale: Modifies state to track an existing resource; does not change the resource itself.
tofu import.translation: Add an existing infrastructure resource to the OpenTofu state.

tofu init.rationale: Downloads providers and modules; does not modify infrastructure.
tofu init.translation: Initialize a working directory containing OpenTofu configuration files.

tofu login.rationale: Stores credentials locally; does not modify infrastructure.
tofu login.translation: Obtain and save credentials for a remote OpenTofu service.

tofu logout.rationale: Deletes stored credentials, which may break automated workflows.
tofu logout.translation: Remove locally stored credentials for a remote OpenTofu service.

tofu output.translation: Display the output values from the OpenTofu state.

tofu plan.rationale: Read-only operation that shows proposed changes without applying them.
tofu plan.translation: Preview the changes OpenTofu would make to match the configuration.

tofu providers.translation: Show the providers required by the current configuration.

tofu refresh.rationale: Modifies state to reflect real infrastructure; may cause unexpected diff in the next plan.
tofu refresh.translation: Update the state file to match the actual state of remote resources.

tofu show.rationale: Read-only display of state or plan contents.
tofu show.translation: Display the current state or a saved plan in a human-readable format.

tofu state.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

tofu state list.translation: List all resources tracked in the OpenTofu state.

tofu state mv.rationale: Renames or restructures resources in state; incorrect moves can cause resources to be recreated or orphaned.
tofu state mv.translation: Move a resource to a different address in the state.

tofu state pull.rationale: Read-only retrieval of the state file.
tofu state pull.translation: Download and display the current remote state.

tofu state push.rationale: Overwrites remote state, which can cause drift or loss of tracking for all managed resources.
tofu state push.translation: Upload a local state file to the remote backend.

tofu state replace-provider.rationale: Changes which provider manages resources; incorrect replacement can cause plan failures or resource recreation.
tofu state replace-provider.translation: Replace the provider for resources in the state.

tofu state rm.rationale: Orphans infrastructure from state management; the resource continues to exist but OpenTofu no longer tracks it.
tofu state rm.translation: Remove a resource from the OpenTofu state without destroying it.

tofu state show.translation: Show the attributes of a single resource in the state.

tofu taint.rationale: Causes the resource to be destroyed and recreated, which may cause downtime or data loss.
tofu taint.translation: Mark a resource instance for forced recreation on the next apply.

tofu test.rationale: May create and destroy temporary infrastructure as part of testing.
tofu test.translation: Run integration tests for OpenTofu modules.

tofu untaint.rationale: Prevents forced recreation; a corrective action that reduces risk.
tofu untaint.translation: Remove the tainted status from a resource instance.

tofu validate.translation: Check whether the OpenTofu configuration files are syntactically valid.

tofu workspace.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

tofu workspace delete.rationale: Removes the workspace and its state; managed resources become untracked.

tofu workspace new.rationale: Creates a new workspace with an empty state; does not modify infrastructure.

tofu workspace select.rationale: Changes which state file is active; subsequent commands will target different infrastructure.
tofu workspace select.translation: Switch to a different OpenTofu workspace.

top.rationale: Read-only monitoring tool that displays process information without modifying anything.
top.translation: Display a live, continuously updating view of running processes and system resource usage.

tops.rationale: Modifies source code files in place to update API usage; original code is overwritten.
tops.translation: Perform scripted API conversions in Objective-C source files.

topsyscall.rationale: Read-only system call monitoring; modifies nothing.
topsyscall.translation: Display the most frequently called system calls in real time.

topsysproc.translation: Display the processes making the most system calls in real time.

touch.rationale: Creates files if they do not exist or updates timestamps; does not modify file contents.
touch.translation: Create empty files or update the timestamps on existing files.

tput.rationale: Sends control sequences to the terminal; changes are cosmetic and session-scoped.
tput.translation: Query or set terminal capabilities using the terminfo database.

tqdm.rationale: Passes data through unchanged while displaying progress; no state modification.
tqdm.translation: Display a progress bar for piped data or iterables.

tr.rationale: Outputs transformed text to the terminal without modifying any files.
tr.translation: Replace, delete, or squeeze characters from input text.

trace.rationale: Read-only kernel tracing that writes events to a file; does not modify system state.
trace.translation: Record and display kernel trace events for performance analysis.

traceroute.rationale: Read-only network diagnostic that maps the route to a destination without modifying anything.
traceroute.translation: Show the network path that packets take to reach a remote host.

traceroute6.rationale: Read-only network diagnostic using probe packets; does not modify any system or network state.
traceroute6.translation: Display the network route that IPv6 packets take to reach a destination.

transformers.rationale: Provides model download and conversion utilities; does not modify existing models without explicit commands.
transformers.translation: Run Hugging Face Transformers CLI utilities for model management.

trap.rationale: Configures signal handlers within the current shell session; does not modify files.
trap.translation: Set up commands to run automatically when the shell receives a signal.

traptoemail.rationale: Sends email based on received traps; messages cannot be unsent once delivered.
traptoemail.translation: Convert SNMP trap notifications into email messages.

trash.rationale: Moves items to Trash rather than permanently deleting; recoverable from Trash until emptied.
trash.translation: Move files and directories to the user's trash folder.

tree.rationale: Read-only directory listing that modifies nothing.
tree.translation: Display the contents of a directory in a tree-like format.

trietool.rationale: Creates trie data files; does not modify existing files.
trietool.translation: Build and query double-array trie data structures for text processing.

trimforce.rationale: Modifies low-level storage behavior; some drives may not handle TRIM correctly, potentially causing data loss.
trimforce.translation: Enable or disable TRIM commands on third-party solid-state drives.

trimforce disable.rationale: Stops sending TRIM commands; a conservative safety measure.
trimforce disable.translation: Disable TRIM commands for third-party drives.

trimforce enable.rationale: Enables TRIM which improves performance but may cause data loss on incompatible drives.
trimforce enable.translation: Enable TRIM commands for third-party drives.

true.rationale: Does nothing except exit with status zero.

truncate.rationale: Shrinking a file permanently discards data beyond the new size; recovery requires backups.
truncate.translation: Set a file to a specified size, extending or shrinking it.

tsc.rationale: Compiles TypeScript files and writes JavaScript output to disk; a standard build step.
tsc.translation: Compile TypeScript source code into JavaScript.

tset.rationale: Configures terminal modes for the current session; resets on terminal close.

tsig-keygen.rationale: Outputs a new authentication key to the terminal; does not modify DNS configuration.
tsig-keygen.translation: Generate authentication keys for DNS transaction security.

tsort.rationale: Reads pairs from input and writes sorted output to the terminal; modifies nothing.
tsort.translation: Perform a topological sort on a directed graph.

ttx.rationale: Creates new XML or font files from existing ones; originals are unchanged.
ttx.translation: Convert between OpenType font files and XML representations.

tty.rationale: Read-only display of terminal device path; modifies nothing.
tty.translation: Print the file name of the terminal connected to standard input.

twine.rationale: Publishes packages to a remote repository; published versions cannot be easily retracted.
twine.translation: Upload Python packages to PyPI or other package repositories.

typer.rationale: Launches Typer-based Python CLI apps or generates completions; risk depends on the app.
typer.translation: Run Typer CLI applications or generate shell completion scripts.

uasysdiagnose.rationale: Read-only diagnostic data collection; does not modify accessibility settings.
uasysdiagnose.translation: Collect diagnostic information about Universal Access services.

ul.rationale: Text formatting filter; writes to the terminal without modifying files.
ul.translation: Translate underline sequences to the terminal's underline capability.

ulimit.rationale: Can restrict resources like open files or memory, which may cause processes to fail if set too low.
ulimit.translation: Display or set resource limits for the shell and its child processes.

umask.rationale: Without arguments, displays the current mask. Setting a mask only affects future files created in the session.
umask.translation: Display or set the default permission mask for newly created files.

umount.rationale: Makes a mounted volume inaccessible; data on the volume is preserved but processes using it may fail.
umount.translation: Unmount a file system from the directory tree.

umtool.rationale: Limited public documentation; exact capabilities are unclear.
umtool.translation: Manage Unified Messaging configurations and diagnostics.

uname.rationale: Read-only display of kernel and OS details; modifies nothing.

uncompress.rationale: Restores the original file from a .Z compressed file; the compressed file is removed after decompression.
uncompress.translation: Decompress files compressed with the compress utility.

unexpand.rationale: Writes converted text to the terminal; does not modify input files.
unexpand.translation: Convert spaces to tabs in text input.

unifdef.rationale: Writes processed output to the terminal by default; does not modify input files.
unifdef.translation: Remove preprocessor conditionals from C source code.

unifdefall.rationale: Writes processed output to the terminal; does not modify input files.
unifdefall.translation: Remove all preprocessor conditionals from C source code.

uniq.rationale: Outputs filtered text without modifying the input file.
uniq.translation: Filter out repeated adjacent lines from a file or input.

units.rationale: Read-only unit conversion calculator that modifies nothing.
units.translation: Convert between different units of measurement.

unlink.rationale: Permanently removes a file; recoverable only from backups or Trash if supported.
unlink.translation: Remove a single file or symbolic link.

unlz4.rationale: Decompresses files creating the original output; source files are preserved by default.

unlzma.rationale: Decompresses files creating the original output; non-destructive.

unvis.rationale: Text decoding filter; writes to the terminal without modifying files.
unvis.translation: Decode strings encoded with the vis utility back to their original form.

unxz.rationale: Decompresses files creating the original output; non-destructive.

unzip.rationale: Extracts files to disk, potentially overwriting existing files at the destination.
unzip.translation: Extract files from a zip archive.

unzipsfx.rationale: Creates a new self-extracting archive file; does not modify existing files.
unzipsfx.translation: Create self-extracting zip archives that can be run as executables.

unzstd.rationale: Decompresses files creating the original output; non-destructive.

update_dyld_shared_cache.rationale: Rebuilds the system shared cache; errors can prevent applications from loading correctly.
update_dyld_shared_cache.translation: Rebuild the dynamic linker shared library cache.

uptime.rationale: Read-only display of system uptime; modifies nothing.
uptime.translation: Display how long the system has been running and the current load averages.

usbdiagnose.rationale: Read-only USB diagnostic data collection; does not modify device state.
usbdiagnose.translation: Collect diagnostic information about USB devices and connections.

usdcat.rationale: Read-only display of USD file contents; modifies nothing.
usdcat.translation: Display the contents of a Universal Scene Description file.

usdchecker.rationale: Read-only validation of USD files; modifies nothing.
usdchecker.translation: Validate a Universal Scene Description file for correctness.

usdcrush.rationale: Modifies the USD file by compressing embedded textures; original texture quality is reduced.
usdcrush.translation: Compress textures in a Universal Scene Description file.

usdextract.rationale: Creates extracted files; does not modify the source USD file.
usdextract.translation: Extract assets from a Universal Scene Description file.

usdrecord.rationale: Creates a rendered image file; does not modify the source USD file.
usdrecord.translation: Render a Universal Scene Description file to an image.

usdtree.rationale: Read-only display of USD scene hierarchy; modifies nothing.
usdtree.translation: Display the hierarchy of prims in a Universal Scene Description file.

usdzip.rationale: Creates a new archive file; source files are unchanged.
usdzip.translation: Package a Universal Scene Description file and its dependencies into a zip archive.

users.rationale: Read-only display of logged-in users; modifies nothing.
users.translation: Display the login names of currently logged-in users.

uttype.rationale: Read-only type identifier lookup; modifies nothing.
uttype.translation: Query Uniform Type Identifier information for file types.

uucp.rationale: Transfers files to remote systems; may overwrite files at the destination.
uucp.translation: Copy files between systems using the Unix-to-Unix Copy protocol.

uudecode.rationale: Creates a decoded output file; does not modify the encoded input.
uudecode.translation: Decode a uuencoded file back to its original binary form.

uuencode.rationale: Writes encoded text to the terminal; does not modify the input file.
uuencode.translation: Encode a binary file into ASCII text for transmission.

uuidgen.rationale: Outputs a random UUID to the terminal; modifies nothing.
uuidgen.translation: Generate a new universally unique identifier.

uvicorn.rationale: Starts a web server to serve a Python application; risk depends on the application code.
uvicorn.translation: Run an ASGI web application server.

vacuumdb.rationale: Reorganizes database storage and updates statistics; locks tables briefly but does not delete data.
vacuumdb.translation: Reclaim storage and optimize a PostgreSQL database.

vacuumlo.rationale: Permanently deletes large objects that are not referenced; incorrect detection may remove needed data.
vacuumlo.translation: Remove orphaned large objects from a PostgreSQL database.

vbnc.rationale: Compiles source into assemblies; does not modify source files.
vbnc.translation: Compile Visual Basic .NET source code using the Mono compiler.

vi.rationale: Opens files for editing; changes are written when the user saves.
vi.translation: Open a file in the vi text editor.

view.rationale: Opens vim without write permission by default; the file cannot be accidentally modified.
view.translation: Open a file in vim in read-only mode.

viewdiagnostic.translation: Display diagnostic information about view hierarchy and layout.

vifs.rationale: Modifies the fstab file which controls automatic file system mounting; errors can prevent volumes from mounting on boot.
vifs.translation: Safely edit the file system mount table in /etc/fstab.

vim.rationale: Opens files for editing; changes are written when the user saves.
vim.translation: Open a file in the Vim text editor.

vimdiff.rationale: Opens files for viewing and optional editing; no modification occurs until the user explicitly saves.
vimdiff.translation: Open two or more files in vim side by side to compare differences.

vimtutor.rationale: Opens a copy of a tutorial file for practice; does not modify any user files.

vipw.rationale: Modifies /etc/passwd which controls user accounts; errors can lock users out of the system.
vipw.translation: Safely edit the system password file.

vis.rationale: Text encoding filter that writes to the terminal; does not modify input files.
vis.translation: Encode non-printable characters in a file into a visible representation.

visudo.rationale: Modifies sudo access control rules; errors can lock out administrative access or grant unintended privileges.
visudo.translation: Safely edit the sudoers file with syntax validation.

vm_stat.rationale: Read-only display of memory page statistics; modifies nothing.
vm_stat.translation: Display virtual memory statistics for the system.

vmmap.rationale: Read-only inspection of process memory layout; does not modify the target process.
vmmap.translation: Display the virtual memory map of a process.

vpnd.rationale: Starts a VPN service that accepts incoming connections; exposes the system as a VPN endpoint.
vpnd.translation: Run the macOS VPN server background service.

vsdbutil.rationale: Modifies volume ownership settings which affect file permissions enforcement.
vsdbutil.translation: Manage the volume status database for ownership and permissions settings.

vtool.rationale: Can modify version load commands in Apple platform binaries; changes affect how the system identifies the binary.
vtool.translation: Display and modify version and build information in Apple platform binaries.

w.rationale: Read-only display of login and process information; modifies nothing.
w.translation: Display who is logged in and what they are doing.

wait.rationale: Only waits for existing processes to complete; modifies nothing.
wait.translation: Pause the shell until one or more background processes finish.

wait4path.rationale: Blocks until a path exists; does not create or modify files.
wait4path.translation: Wait for a specified file system path to appear.

wall.rationale: Sends a text message to terminals; does not modify files or system state.
wall.translation: Broadcast a message to all logged-in users.

watch.rationale: Repeatedly executes the given command; on its own it only displays output and modifies nothing.
watch.translation: Run a command repeatedly and display its output.

watchfiles.rationale: Monitors file changes; the executed command determines the actual risk.
watchfiles.translation: Watch for file system changes and run a command when files are modified.

wc.rationale: Read-only operation that displays counts without modifying any files.
wc.translation: Count lines, words, and bytes in files.

wdutil.rationale: Primarily diagnostic; collects Wi-Fi logs and state information.
wdutil.translation: Collect wireless diagnostic information and manage Wi-Fi settings.

wdutil diagnose.rationale: Collects diagnostic information into files; does not change network settings.
wdutil diagnose.translation: Run all wireless diagnostic tests and save the results to a directory.

wdutil dump.rationale: Writes buffered log data to a file; does not change network settings.
wdutil dump.translation: Save the temporary Wi-Fi log buffer to a file.

wdutil info.rationale: Read-only display of Wi-Fi status; modifies nothing.
wdutil info.translation: Display detailed information about the current Wi-Fi environment.

wdutil log.rationale: Toggles diagnostic logging categories; does not change network connectivity.
wdutil log.translation: Enable or disable logging for specific network services.

wfsctl.rationale: Enables or configures WebDAV sharing which exposes files over the network.
wfsctl.translation: Configure the WebDAV file sharing service.

what.rationale: Read-only extraction of version strings; modifies nothing.
what.translation: Display identification strings embedded in binary files.

whatis.rationale: Read-only search of man page database; modifies nothing.
whatis.translation: Display one-line manual page descriptions for commands.

whereis.rationale: Read-only file location search; modifies nothing.
whereis.translation: Locate the binary, source, and manual page for a command.

which.rationale: Read-only lookup that displays file paths without modifying anything.
which.translation: Show the full path of a command by searching the system PATH.

who.rationale: Read-only display of login information; modifies nothing.
who.translation: Display information about currently logged-in users.

whoami.rationale: Read-only display of the current user identity; modifies nothing.
whoami.translation: Display the current effective user name.

whois.translation: Query domain name registration and network information databases.

wish.rationale: Launches a GUI scripting interpreter; risk depends on scripts executed.
wish.translation: Run the Tcl/Tk windowing shell interpreter.

write.rationale: Sends text to another user's terminal; does not modify files.
write.translation: Send a message to another logged-in user's terminal.

wrjpgcom.rationale: Modifies JPEG file metadata by adding a comment; the image data is unchanged but the file is rewritten.
wrjpgcom.translation: Insert a comment into a JPEG file.

wsdl.rationale: Generates source code files from a service definition; does not modify existing code.
wsdl.translation: Generate .NET proxy client code from a web service description definition.

xar.rationale: Archive operations create or extract files; originals are unchanged during extraction.
xar.translation: Create, extract, and manipulate extensible archives.

xargs.rationale: Constructs and executes commands from piped input; the risk depends on which command is being run.
xargs.translation: Build and run commands using input read from a pipe or file.

xattr.rationale: Can modify or delete extended attributes which may include security metadata like quarantine flags.
xattr.translation: Display, set, or remove extended attributes on files.

xbuild.rationale: Compiles source code into build outputs; does not modify source files.
xbuild.translation: Build .NET projects using the Mono MSBuild-compatible build system.

xcode-select.rationale: Changes which Xcode installation provides developer tools; affects all build operations on the system.
xcode-select.translation: Manage the active Xcode developer tools installation path.

xcodebuild.rationale: Compiles source code and produces build products; does not modify source files.
xcodebuild.translation: Build Xcode projects and workspaces from the command line.

xcrun.rationale: Finds and executes Xcode tools; risk depends on the tool being run.
xcrun.translation: Locate and run developer tools from the active Xcode installation.

xctrace.rationale: Captures performance data into trace files; does not modify the profiled application.
xctrace.translation: Record, import, and export Instruments performance traces.

xed.rationale: Launches Xcode with specified files; does not modify files itself.
xed.translation: Open files or projects in Xcode.

xgettext.rationale: Reads source files and creates a new .pot file; does not modify source code.
xgettext.translation: Extract translatable strings from source code into a PO template file.

xip.rationale: Creates or extracts signed xip archives; extraction creates new files without modifying originals.
xip.translation: Create or expand secure signed archives used for Apple software distribution.

xmlcatalog.rationale: Manages XML entity resolution catalogs; modifications are to catalog metadata only.
xmlcatalog.translation: Query and modify XML and Standard Generalized Markup Language catalog files.

xmllint.rationale: Reads and validates XML; writes formatted output to the terminal by default.
xmllint.translation: Parse, validate, and reformat XML documents.

xpath.rationale: Read-only querying of XML content; does not modify files.
xpath.translation: Evaluate XPath expressions against XML documents.

xprotect.rationale: Controls system malware protection; disabling or modifying rules affects security posture.
xprotect.translation: Manage the macOS XProtect malware detection system.

xsanctl.rationale: Manages storage area network volumes and configuration; incorrect changes can disrupt shared storage access.
xsanctl.translation: Control and configure Xsan storage area network volumes.

xsd.rationale: Generates source code from schema files; does not modify existing code.
xsd.translation: Generate .NET classes from XML Schema definitions.

xsltproc.rationale: Transforms XML and writes output to the terminal or a file; does not modify input files.
xsltproc.translation: Apply transformation stylesheets to transform XML documents.

xsp.rationale: Starts a local development web server; risk depends on the hosted application.
xsp.translation: Run the Mono ASP.NET development web server.

xxd.rationale: Reads a file and outputs hex representation; reverse mode creates a new file from hex input.
xxd.translation: Create a hex dump of a file or convert a hex dump back to binary.

xz.rationale: Compresses files in place, replacing the original with a .xz file by default.
xz.translation: Compress files using the xz algorithm.

xzcat.rationale: Read-only decompression to the terminal; does not modify any files.
xzcat.translation: Decompress XZ files and write the output to the terminal.

xzcmp.translation: Compare XZ-compressed files without decompressing them to disk.

xzdec.rationale: Read-only decompression to the terminal; does not modify files.
xzdec.translation: Decompress XZ files and print the output.

xzgrep.translation: Search for patterns in XZ-compressed files.

xzless.translation: View XZ-compressed files one page at a time.

xzmore.translation: View XZ-compressed files one page at a time.

yaa.rationale: Archive operations create or extract files; originals are unchanged.
yaa.translation: Create and extract Apple Archive files.

yacc.rationale: Creates parser source files from grammar input; does not modify the grammar file.
yacc.translation: Generate a parser from a grammar specification.

yarn.rationale: The bare command runs install by default; equivalent to yarn install.
yarn.translation: Run the Yarn package manager for JavaScript projects.

yarn add.rationale: Downloads and installs a package, modifying package.json and the lockfile.
yarn add.translation: Add a dependency to the project.

yarn cache clean.rationale: Deletes cached packages; they will be re-downloaded on next install.
yarn cache clean.translation: Remove shared cache files used by Yarn.

yarn dedupe.rationale: Modifies the lockfile and may change which versions are installed.
yarn dedupe.translation: Remove duplicate dependency versions by consolidating ranges.

yarn dlx.rationale: Downloads and executes remote code from the registry.
yarn dlx.translation: Run a package in a temporary environment without installing it permanently.

yarn exec.rationale: Runs an arbitrary command with access to project binaries.
yarn exec.translation: Execute a shell command in the project environment.

yarn init.rationale: Creates a configuration file; does not install anything.
yarn init.translation: Create a new package.json file in the current directory.

yarn install.rationale: Downloads and installs packages from the registry, which execute install scripts that may modify the system.
yarn install.translation: Install all dependencies listed in the project's package.json.

yarn link.rationale: Creates a symbolic link for local development; easily reversible.
yarn link.translation: Connect the local project to another local package for development.

yarn npm audit.translation: Check installed packages for known security vulnerabilities.

yarn npm publish.rationale: Makes the package publicly available on the registry, which is difficult to fully undo.
yarn npm publish.translation: Publish a package to the npm registry.

yarn pack.rationale: Creates a local archive file; does not publish anything.
yarn pack.translation: Generate a tarball from the current workspace.

yarn rebuild.rationale: Re-runs native build scripts, which may compile code and modify the local environment.

yarn remove.rationale: Uninstalls a package and modifies package.json and the lockfile.
yarn remove.translation: Remove a dependency from the project.

yarn run.rationale: Executes an arbitrary script, which may perform any action.
yarn run.translation: Run a script defined in the project's package.json.

yarn set version.rationale: Downloads a specific Yarn binary for the project; does not affect dependencies.
yarn set version.translation: Lock the Yarn version used by the project.

yarn unlink.rationale: Removes a development symbolic link and reinstalls the normal dependency.
yarn unlink.translation: Disconnect the local project from a linked package.

yarn up.rationale: Modifies the lockfile and installs new package versions that may introduce breaking changes.
yarn up.translation: Update project dependencies to newer versions.

yarn upgrade.rationale: Modifies the lockfile and installs new package versions that may introduce breaking changes.
yarn upgrade.translation: Update project dependencies to newer versions.

yarnpkg.rationale: Installs, updates, and removes npm packages; modifies node_modules and lockfiles.
yarnpkg.translation: Run the Yarn JavaScript package manager.

yes.rationale: Outputs text to the terminal indefinitely; modifies nothing.
yes.translation: Repeatedly output a string until terminated.

zcat.rationale: Read-only decompression to the terminal; does not modify files.
zcat.translation: Decompress gzip files and write the output to the terminal.

zcmp.translation: Compare gzip-compressed files without decompressing to disk.

zdump.rationale: Read-only time zone query; modifies nothing.
zdump.translation: Display current time in specified time zones.

zforce.rationale: Renames files to add the correct extension; the file content is unchanged.
zforce.translation: Add a .gz extension to gzip-compressed files that lack one.

zgrep.translation: Search for patterns in gzip-compressed files.

zic.rationale: Modifies the system timezone database; incorrect definitions can cause time calculation errors.
zic.translation: Compile time zone definition files into the system timezone database.

zip.rationale: Creates an archive file; does not modify the source files.

zipcloak.rationale: Modifies the zip archive in place by adding or removing encryption.
zipcloak.translation: Encrypt or decrypt entries in a zip archive.

zipgrep.rationale: Read-only search within archive contents; modifies nothing.
zipgrep.translation: Search for patterns in files within a zip archive.

zipinfo.rationale: Read-only display of archive metadata; modifies nothing.
zipinfo.translation: Display detailed information about files within a zip archive.

zipnote.rationale: Can modify zip archive comments in place; file data is unchanged but the archive is rewritten.
zipnote.translation: Read or write comments in a zip archive.

zipsplit.rationale: Creates new zip files from an existing archive; the original is unchanged.
zipsplit.translation: Split a zip archive into smaller parts.

zless.translation: View gzip-compressed files one page at a time.

zmore.translation: View gzip-compressed files one page at a time.

znew.rationale: Replaces .Z compressed files with .gz equivalents; the original .Z file is removed.

zprint.rationale: Read-only display of kernel memory zone information; modifies nothing.
zprint.translation: Display kernel zone memory allocation statistics.

zsh.rationale: Launches an interactive shell; the shell itself is just an interpreter.
zsh.translation: Run the Z shell command interpreter.

zstd.rationale: Compresses files, creating a new .zst file; original is kept by default unlike gzip.
zstd.translation: Compress or decompress files using the Zstandard algorithm.

zstdcat.rationale: Read-only decompression to the terminal; does not modify files.
zstdcat.translation: Decompress Zstandard files and write the output to the terminal.

zstdgrep.translation: Search for patterns in Zstandard-compressed files.

zstdless.translation: View Zstandard-compressed files one page at a time.

zstdmt.rationale: Creates compressed or decompressed output files; originals are unchanged by default.
zstdmt.translation: Compress or decompress files using Zstandard with multi-threaded processing.

AssetCacheManagerUtil --all.rationale: Affects all cached content; re-downloading may be slow on limited bandwidth.

SetFile -a.rationale: Changes file attributes like visibility and lock status; incorrect settings may hide files or prevent editing.

SetFile -c.rationale: Changes legacy creator metadata; minimal practical impact on modern macOS.

SetFile -d.rationale: Modifies file creation timestamp; cosmetic metadata change.

SetFile -m.rationale: Modifies file modification timestamp; cosmetic metadata change.

SetFile -t.rationale: Changes legacy type metadata; minimal practical impact on modern macOS.

ab -A.rationale: Sends credentials to the server; may expose them if the connection is not encrypted.
ab -A.translation_modifier: authenticating with a username and password

ab -C.rationale: Sends cookie data; does not change the operation's scope.
ab -C.translation_modifier: including a cookie with each request

ab -H.rationale: Adds a header to requests; does not change the operation's scope.

ab -T.rationale: Sets the content-type header; does not change the operation's scope.
ab -T.translation_modifier: using a specified content type for the request body

ab -X.rationale: Redirects traffic through a proxy; does not change what data is sent.
ab -X.translation_modifier: routing requests through a specified proxy server

ab -c.rationale: High concurrency can overwhelm the target server and degrade its performance for other users.
ab -c.translation_modifier: sending multiple requests at the same time

ab -e.rationale: Writes benchmark statistics to a local file; does not affect the server.
ab -e.translation_modifier: saving response time percentiles to a CSV file

ab -g.rationale: Writes benchmark data to a local file; does not affect the server.
ab -g.translation_modifier: saving detailed timing data to a file for graphing

ab -i.rationale: Retrieves only headers; reduces the amount of data transferred.
ab -i.translation_modifier: requesting only response headers without downloading content

ab -k.rationale: Enables keep-alive to reduce connection overhead; does not change what is sent.

ab -m.rationale: Changes the HTTP verb; does not inherently increase risk beyond the base command.

ab -n.rationale: Controls the number of requests; more requests increase server load but do not modify data.
ab -n.translation_modifier: sending a specified total number of requests

ab -p.rationale: Sends data to the server, which could trigger state changes on the target.
ab -p.translation_modifier: sending data from a file to create or update a resource on the server

ab -r.rationale: Prevents the benchmark from stopping on errors; does not change what is sent.
ab -r.translation_modifier: continuing even when receiving network connection errors

ab -s.rationale: Changes the wait time per request; does not change the operation's scope.
ab -s.translation_modifier: setting a custom timeout in seconds for each request

ab -t.rationale: Limits the test duration; does not change the nature of the requests.
ab -t.translation_modifier: running the benchmark for a specified number of seconds

ab -u.rationale: Sends data to the server, which could create or overwrite resources on the target.
ab -u.translation_modifier: sending data from a file to replace a resource on the server

afconvert -b.rationale: Controls output quality and file size; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -c.rationale: Controls channel count in the output; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -d.rationale: Controls the output encoding; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -l.rationale: Controls channel mapping in the output; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -m.rationale: Controls which input channels appear in the output; does not affect the source file.
afconvert -m.translation_modifier: remapping input channels to specified output channels

afconvert -o.rationale: Explicitly names the output file; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -q.rationale: Controls encoding quality; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -r.rationale: Controls resampling quality; does not affect the source file.

afconvert -s.rationale: Selects constant, average, or variable bitrate encoding; does not affect the source file.
afconvert -s.translation_modifier: using a specified bitrate allocation strategy

afinfo -b.rationale: Changes output format to a shorter display; still read-only.

afinfo -i.rationale: Shows additional metadata fields; still read-only.

afinfo -r.rationale: Reads the full file for accurate duration; still read-only.
afinfo -r.translation_modifier: calculating the actual duration by counting all audio packets

afinfo -x.rationale: Changes output to XML format; still read-only.

afplay -q.rationale: Controls resampling quality; no state change beyond audio output.
afplay -q.translation_modifier: using a specified quality level for rate-scaled playback

afplay -r.rationale: Adjusts playback rate; purely cosmetic adjustment to audio output.

afplay -t.rationale: Limits playback duration; no additional risk.
afplay -t.translation_modifier: for a specified number of seconds

afplay -v.rationale: Adjusts playback volume; no state change beyond audio output.

alias -p.rationale: Read-only display of existing aliases; modifies nothing.

app-sso --force.rationale: Bypasses confirmation for single sign-on configuration changes.
app-sso --force.translation_modifier: forcing the SSO operation without prompting

app-sso --reset.rationale: Removes SSO configuration; users must re-authenticate with all services.

ar -c.rationale: Cosmetic change that silences an informational message.
ar -c.translation_modifier: suppressing the message when a new archive is created

ar -d.rationale: Removes members from an archive, which may break builds if the wrong file is deleted.
ar -d.translation_modifier: deleting specified files from the archive

ar -q.rationale: Appends to the archive without verifying whether the file already exists; faster but may create duplicates.

ar -r.rationale: Adds or updates archive members; the archive can be rebuilt if needed.

ar -s.rationale: Updates the archive index, equivalent to running ranlib; does not alter archive members.

ar -t.translation_modifier: listing the files contained in the archive

ar -u.rationale: Restricts updates to files with a more recent modification time, reducing unnecessary changes.

ar -v.rationale: Increases verbosity of output without changing behavior.

ar -x.rationale: Writes files to disk, but only overwrites existing files with the archived versions.

arch -32.rationale: Selects a different architecture variant but does not modify any files or system state.
arch -32.translation_modifier: using the 32-bit version of the program

arch -64.rationale: Selects a different architecture variant but does not modify any files or system state.
arch -64.translation_modifier: using the 64-bit version of the program

arch -arch.rationale: Selects a specific architecture variant but does not modify any files or system state.

arch -c.rationale: Only affects the environment passed to the child process; does not modify files or system state.
arch -c.translation_modifier: clearing all environment variables before running the program

arch -d.rationale: Only affects the environment passed to the child process; does not modify files or system state.
arch -d.translation_modifier: removing an environment variable before running the program

arch -e.rationale: Only affects the environment passed to the child process; does not modify files or system state.
arch -e.translation_modifier: setting an environment variable for the program

arp -S.rationale: Deletes and recreates an address mapping, which temporarily disrupts connectivity to that host.
arp -S.translation_modifier: replacing any existing entry with a new static entry

arp -a.rationale: Read-only display of all cached address mappings.
arp -a.translation_modifier: showing all entries in the table

arp -d.rationale: Removes an address mapping, which can disrupt network connectivity to the affected host.
arp -d.translation_modifier: deleting an entry from the table

arp -f.rationale: Bulk-loads address mappings from a file, which could disrupt connectivity if entries are incorrect.
arp -f.translation_modifier: reading multiple entries from a file

arp -i.rationale: Narrows the scope of the operation to one interface; does not increase risk.
arp -i.translation_modifier: limited to a specific network interface

arp -n.rationale: Only changes output formatting; does not modify any data.
arp -n.translation_modifier: showing addresses as numbers instead of resolving names

arp -s.rationale: Creates a permanent address mapping that overrides automatic resolution and persists until manually removed.
arp -s.translation_modifier: adding a static entry to the table

asr restore --erase.rationale: Completely wipes the destination volume before writing; all existing data is destroyed.
asr restore --erase.translation_modifier: erasing the target volume before restoring

asr restore --noprompt.rationale: Suppresses the confirmation prompt, increasing the chance of accidental data loss.
asr restore --noprompt.translation_modifier: without asking for confirmation before erasing the target

asr restore --noverify.rationale: Skips integrity checks after restoring, which may leave corrupted data undetected.
asr restore --noverify.translation_modifier: skipping verification of the restored data

asr restore --source.rationale: Only identifies the source; the destructive action is in the restore itself.
asr restore --source.translation_modifier: specifying the disk image or volume to copy from

asr restore --target.rationale: Only identifies the destination; the destructive action is in the restore itself.
asr restore --target.translation_modifier: specifying the volume to overwrite with the restored data

at -c.rationale: Read-only display of a job's commands.
at -c.translation_modifier: displaying the contents of a scheduled job

at -f.rationale: Runs the contents of a file as a scheduled job; risk depends on the file contents.
at -f.translation_modifier: reading the command from a file instead of typed input

at -l.translation_modifier: listing scheduled jobs instead of creating one

at -m.rationale: Only adds a notification; does not change what the job does.
at -m.translation_modifier: sending an email when the job finishes even if there was no output

at -q.rationale: Only changes which queue the job is placed in; does not affect what runs.

at -r.rationale: Deletes a pending job, which cannot be recovered but prevents unwanted execution.
at -r.translation_modifier: removing a scheduled job instead of creating one

at -t.rationale: Only changes how the scheduled time is specified; does not affect what runs.
at -t.translation_modifier: specifying the time in numeric year-month-day-hour-minute format

at -v.rationale: Only adds informational output; does not change behavior.
at -v.translation_modifier: showing the time the job will run

autopoint --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

avbcapture --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing the existing output file.

avconvert --disableFastStart.rationale: Reduces disk access during conversion; affects only playback start behavior of the output.
avconvert --disableFastStart.translation_modifier: without optimizing the file for streaming playback

avconvert --disableMetadataFilter.rationale: Retains privacy-sensitive metadata that is normally stripped; no destructive action.
avconvert --disableMetadataFilter.translation_modifier: preserving all source metadata including location and device information

avconvert --duration.rationale: Trims the output length; does not affect the source file.
avconvert --duration.translation_modifier: limiting the output to a specified number of seconds

avconvert --multiPass.rationale: Increases encoding quality at the cost of time; does not affect the source file.

avconvert --replace.rationale: Replaces an existing file without confirmation; the overwritten file is lost.
avconvert --replace.translation_modifier: overwriting the output file if it already exists

avconvert --start.rationale: Trims the beginning of the output; does not affect the source file.
avconvert --start.translation_modifier: skipping the first specified number of seconds of the source

avconvert -o.rationale: Names the output file; does not affect the source.
avconvert -o.translation_modifier: writing to a specified output file

avconvert -p.rationale: Selects encoding parameters; does not affect the source file.
avconvert -p.translation_modifier: using a specified quality and resolution preset

avconvert -s.rationale: Identifies the input file; does not modify it.
avconvert -s.translation_modifier: from a specified source media file

avconvert -v.rationale: Enables verbose output during conversion; no state change.

awk -F.rationale: Changes how input is divided into columns; does not modify files.
awk -F.translation_modifier: using a specified character to split each line into fields

awk -f.rationale: Loads the program from a file; does not add any destructive capability.
awk -f.translation_modifier: reading the processing program from a file instead of the command line

awk -v.rationale: Passes a value into the program; does not change how files are handled.
awk -v.translation_modifier: setting a variable to a given value before processing begins

aws --no-cli-pager.rationale: Disables the pager for output; no resources are modified.

aws --output.rationale: Changes output format only; no resources are modified.

aws --profile.rationale: Switches the identity used for all operations; the wrong profile may target a different account or have different permissions.
aws --profile.translation_modifier: using a named credential profile instead of the default

aws --region.rationale: Operations will affect resources in the specified region; the wrong region may target production instead of staging.

aws ec2 run-instances --dry-run.rationale: No instances are created; only checks permissions and validates parameters.
aws ec2 run-instances --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the launch without actually creating any instances

aws ec2 terminate-instances --dry-run.rationale: No instances are terminated; only checks permissions.
aws ec2 terminate-instances --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the termination without actually destroying any instances

aws rds delete-db-instance --skip-final-.rationale: Skips the final snapshot, making the data permanently irrecoverable after deletion.
aws rds delete-db-instance --skip-final-.translation_modifier: without creating a final backup snapshot of the data

aws s3 cp --acl.rationale: Incorrect ACLs can expose objects publicly or restrict legitimate access.
aws s3 cp --acl.translation_modifier: setting the access control policy on the destination objects

aws s3 cp --dryrun.rationale: No data is transferred; only shows what would happen.
aws s3 cp --dryrun.translation_modifier: simulating the operation without actually copying anything

aws s3 cp --recursive.rationale: Copies entire directory trees, increasing the scope and potential for unintended overwrites.
aws s3 cp --recursive.translation_modifier: including all files in all subdirectories

aws s3 cp --sse.translation_modifier: encrypting the destination objects with server-side encryption

aws s3 ls --recursive.rationale: Widens the listing but remains read-only.
aws s3 ls --recursive.translation_modifier: including all objects in all subdirectories

aws s3 mv --dryrun.rationale: No data is transferred or deleted; only shows what would happen.
aws s3 mv --dryrun.translation_modifier: simulating the operation without actually moving anything

aws s3 mv --recursive.rationale: Moves entire directory trees, deleting all source files after transfer.
aws s3 mv --recursive.translation_modifier: including all files in all subdirectories

aws s3 rb --force.rationale: Empties and destroys the entire bucket and all its contents permanently.
aws s3 rb --force.translation_modifier: first deleting all objects in the bucket before removing it

aws s3 rm --dryrun.rationale: No objects are deleted; only shows what would be removed.
aws s3 rm --dryrun.translation_modifier: simulating the deletion without actually removing anything

aws s3 rm --exclude.rationale: Narrows scope by excluding matching objects; the destructive risk is in the base command and --recursive.
aws s3 rm --exclude.translation_modifier: skipping objects matching the specified pattern

aws s3 rm --include.rationale: Narrows scope to matching objects; the destructive risk is in the base command and --recursive.
aws s3 rm --include.translation_modifier: only for objects matching the specified pattern

aws s3 rm --recursive.rationale: Deletes all objects matching the prefix, potentially wiping entire bucket contents.
aws s3 rm --recursive.translation_modifier: including all objects under the specified prefix

aws s3 sync --delete.rationale: Deletes destination objects not present in the source, which can cause permanent data loss.
aws s3 sync --delete.translation_modifier: removing files in the destination that do not exist in the source

aws s3 sync --dryrun.rationale: No data is modified; only shows what would happen.
aws s3 sync --dryrun.translation_modifier: simulating the sync without actually transferring or deleting anything

aws ssm get-parameter --with-decryption.rationale: Reveals the plaintext value of encrypted secrets.
aws ssm get-parameter --with-decryption.translation_modifier: decrypting the value if it is a SecureString

aws ssm put-parameter --overwrite.rationale: Overwrites the current value, which may affect running applications that reference it.

base64 --decode.rationale: Changes the direction of transformation; still outputs to the terminal.
base64 --decode.translation_modifier: decoding base64 input instead of encoding

base64 -b.rationale: Only affects output formatting; no data modification.
base64 -b.translation_modifier: inserting line breaks at a specified character interval

base64 -d.rationale: Changes the direction of transformation; still outputs to the terminal.
base64 -d.translation_modifier: decoding base64 input instead of encoding

base64 -i.rationale: Changes the input source; no data is modified.
base64 -i.translation_modifier: reading from a specified input file

base64 -o.rationale: Writes to a file that may overwrite existing data.
base64 -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file

basename -a.rationale: Allows multiple arguments; still a read-only string operation.
basename -a.translation_modifier: processing multiple paths at once instead of just one

basename -s.rationale: Strips a trailing extension or suffix; still a read-only string operation.
basename -s.translation_modifier: removing a specified suffix from the end of the file name

bash --login.rationale: Executes login profile scripts which may modify the environment or run commands.
bash --login.translation_modifier: as a login shell, sourcing profile and login configuration files

bash --noprofile.rationale: Skips login scripts, reducing the chance of unintended side effects from profile files.
bash --noprofile.translation_modifier: without sourcing login profile configuration files

bash --norc.rationale: Skips the .bashrc file, ensuring a clean environment without user customizations.
bash --norc.translation_modifier: without sourcing the shell startup configuration file

bash --posix.rationale: Restricts behavior to POSIX standards; disables some Bash-specific extensions.
bash --posix.translation_modifier: in POSIX-compliant mode, following the POSIX standard more strictly

bash -B.rationale: Enables brace expansion for pattern generation; default behavior in most configurations.

bash -C.rationale: A protective measure that prevents accidental file overwrites via redirection.
bash -C.translation_modifier: preventing output redirection from overwriting existing files

bash -c.rationale: Runs inline commands directly; the risk depends entirely on what the command does.
bash -c.translation_modifier: executing a command string passed as an argument

bash -e.rationale: Adds stricter error handling; a safety-enhancing option.
bash -e.translation_modifier: exiting immediately if any command fails

bash -i.rationale: Starts an interactive session; the risk is inherent to an open shell.
bash -i.translation_modifier: in interactive mode with a prompt and job control

bash -n.rationale: Validates syntax without running any commands; no side effects.

bash -o.rationale: Modifies shell behavior settings; individual options vary but the flag itself is configuration.
bash -o.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling a named shell option

bash -p.rationale: Prevents inheriting potentially unsafe environment settings from the caller.
bash -p.translation_modifier: in privileged mode, not processing startup files and not inheriting the environment

bash -r.rationale: Disables cd, setting PATH, and other actions; a security-hardening measure.
bash -r.translation_modifier: in restricted mode, limiting certain operations

bash -s.rationale: Executes whatever is piped in; the risk depends on the input source.

bash -u.rationale: Catches common scripting mistakes by erroring on undefined variables.
bash -u.translation_modifier: treating unset variables as an error

bash -v.rationale: Adds verbose output; does not change what commands are executed.
bash -v.translation_modifier: printing each line of the script as it is read

bash -x.rationale: Adds debug tracing; does not change what commands are executed.
bash -x.translation_modifier: printing each command before executing it

batch -f.rationale: Runs the contents of a file as a scheduled job; risk depends on the file contents.
batch -f.translation_modifier: reading the command from a file instead of typed input

batch -m.rationale: Only adds a notification; does not change what the job does.
batch -m.translation_modifier: sending an email when the job finishes even if there was no output

batch -q.rationale: Only changes which queue the job is placed in; does not affect what runs.

batch -v.rationale: Only adds informational output; does not change behavior.
batch -v.translation_modifier: showing the time the job will run

bc -e.rationale: Runs a calculation from the command line instead of interactively; read-only.

bc -i.rationale: Enables interactive prompts; no effect on data or files.

bc -l.rationale: Preloads math functions like sine and cosine; read-only computation.

bc -q.rationale: Cosmetic change that hides the welcome message.

bc -s.rationale: Disables non-standard extensions; limits functionality but modifies nothing.
bc -s.translation_modifier: restricting to the standard feature set only

bc -w.rationale: Enables extra warning messages without changing computation behavior.

bioutil --delete.rationale: Permanently removes biometric data; re-enrollment required.

bison -d.rationale: Creates an additional output file; does not execute anything.

bison -g.rationale: Creates an additional visualization file; read-only diagnostic.

bison -v.rationale: Produces an extra report file for debugging; read-only diagnostic.

black --diff.rationale: Read-only diff output; no files are modified.

black --exclude.rationale: Narrows which files are processed; does not change formatting behavior.

black --include.rationale: Narrows which files are processed; does not change formatting behavior.

black --line-length.rationale: Changes a formatting preference; does not affect file modification behavior.
